Role Title: Customer Service Expert – Phone Support (LATAM)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Latam remote

Mexico, Central America, Colombia, Peru, Ecuador, Argentina, Chile and Brazil.

micro1 is engaging Customer Service Experts to contribute to a customer’s project, delivering phone-based support across the United States. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. As an independent contractor, you will represent customers during live calls, handling communications with businesses and service providers to complete everyday tasks. This remote engagement prioritizes written and verbal English communication and seeks proactive professionals from LATAM regions.

Scope of Work

  1. Place and receive phone calls on behalf of customers to complete tasks including reservations, appointment scheduling, and vendor confirmations.
  2. Engage with businesses and service providers, ensuring clear, professional communication to gather information and fulfill requests.
  3. Efficiently navigate phone menus, hold queues, and call centers to reach the appropriate contact for each task.
  4. Document outcomes and important details for every call interaction with accuracy and attention to confidentiality.
  5. Handle a high volume of short, consecutive calls addressing a variety of customer needs.
  6. Collaborate with other remote professionals to ensure a consistent, high-quality customer service experience.
  7. Uphold the highest standards of professionalism and discretion with sensitive customer information.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Demonstrated experience in executive assistance, virtual assistance, concierge services, or customer support via phone.
  2. Fluent, neutral, and clear spoken English with strong improvisational and live conversation skills for US-based interactions.
  3. Confidence in making outbound calls, including cold calls, and efficiently navigating automated phone systems.
  4. Reliable high-speed internet connection, quiet work environment, and a quality wired or USB headset.
  5. Experience in the hospitality, restaurant, or travel industries; negotiation or escalation experience is a plus.
  6. Proven ability to work autonomously, manage multiple consecutive tasks, and deliver high-quality service remotely.

Compensation Structure

Representatives are paid for scheduled, available hours — not per call completed.

Start Timeline & Availability

This role requires committed, shift-based availability — representatives must be fully active and responsive for the entire duration of every scheduled shift. This would be an initial 4-week engagement, with representatives working four 5-hour shifts per week (up to 20 hours/week). Genuine weekend availability is required for a portion of the team.

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and expect selected candidates to start their first shifts within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

jobs.excerpt: At Nüvitek, customer success is our Ethos; together, we drive transformational outcomes.
jobs.description:
At Nüvitek, customer success is our Ethos; together, we drive transformational outcomes. We only succeed when our customers succeed. We partner with our customers to achieve business objectives by using our proven customer-centric, value-driven business practices and service delivery methodologies.

Nüvitek is seeking a Senior Power BI Analyst to lead the design, development, and implementation of advanced business intelligence solutions using Power BI, Power Query, DAX, and related technologies. This role will serve as a technical expert in data analysis and business intelligence, leveraging AI technologies to uncover insights and support data-driven decision-making. The ideal candidate will provide technical leadership, evaluate emerging BI and AI capabilities, and help shape innovative analytics solutions.

In assuming this position, you will be a critical contributor to meeting Nuvitek's mission: To deliver innovative, cost-effective solutions and services that enable our customers to rapidly adapt to dynamic environments.

What you will do

  • Lead the design, development, implementation, and maintenance of complex business intelligence and data visualization solutions using Microsoft Power BI and related Microsoft technologies.
  • Design and develop sophisticated Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, and data visualizations that transform complex data into actionable business insights.
  • Develop advanced data transformation and analytical solutions using Power Query, DAX, and related tools.
  • Analyze complex datasets to identify meaningful patterns, trends, relationships, and opportunities that support data-driven decision-making.
  • Apply advanced analytical techniques and emerging AI technologies to enhance business intelligence capabilities and uncover deeper insights from organizational data.
  • Lead major technical assignments involving business intelligence, data analysis, reporting, and analytics solutions across multiple projects.
  • Evaluate business intelligence solution performance and recommend significant improvements to enhance usability, efficiency, scalability, and overall business value.
  • Serve as a technical expert and subject matter resource for Power BI, data analysis, business intelligence, and related technologies across multiple project assignments.
  • Provide authoritative technical guidance on data analysis and business intelligence approaches, methodologies, and best practices.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, data engineers, technical teams, and leadership to understand business objectives and translate them into effective analytical solutions.
  • Develop and communicate data-driven findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Establish and promote standards for Power BI development, data visualization, analytical methodologies, and business intelligence practices.
  • Evaluate emerging business intelligence, analytics, and AI technologies and identify opportunities to incorporate them into Nüvitek solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership during solution design, development, implementation, testing, and deployment activities.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to other analysts and team members working with Power BI and business intelligence technologies.
  • Contribute to the advancement of organizational business intelligence practices, methodologies, and technical capabilities.

What you will bring

  • Obtain a Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field.
  • 8 years of relevant professional experience in business intelligence, data analytics, data visualization, or a related technical discipline.
  • At least 3 years of experience working with AI technologies in support of analytics, business intelligence, data analysis, or related solutions.
  • Advanced hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI.
  • Strong experience with Power Query, DAX, data modeling, and Power BI semantic models.
  • Experience designing and implementing complex business intelligence solutions from requirements through deployment and maintenance.
  • Advanced ability to analyze large and complex datasets and identify meaningful patterns, trends, and insights.
  • Experience translating complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for business and organizational stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of business intelligence principles, data visualization practices, analytical methodologies, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Experience evaluating BI solution performance and recommending improvements to scalability, usability, efficiency, and maintainability.
  • Ability to serve as a technical expert across multiple concurrent assignments.
  • Strong understanding of emerging AI and analytics technologies and their application to business intelligence.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.


It would be great if you also had
  • Experience supporting federal government customers or government contracting environments.
  • Microsoft Power BI or related Microsoft certifications.
  • Experience establishing Power BI governance, development standards, security models, and enterprise BI practices.
  • Experience with advanced statistical analysis, predictive analytics, or machine learning.
  • Experience leading BI strategy, modernization, or enterprise analytics initiatives.

Benefits

Nuvitek is proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package:
  • Medical Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Disability and Life Insurance
  • Parental Leave
  • 401K
  • Paid Time Off
Equal Opportunity Employer StatementNuvitek is an equal-opportunity employer as to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.

Nüvitek uses artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist with the review and organization of job applications. AI-assisted tools may be used to help identify application information relevant to the position; however, AI does not make hiring decisions. Employment decisions are made by Nüvitek through human review and consideration of candidate qualifications.

jobs.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:

At BeOne, our Global Development SuperHighway — our integrated, end-to-end, wholly internal development capability — is a cornerstone of our R&D vision. It brings together a unique set of internal cross-functional capabilities from across the globe needed for efficient delivery of clinical trials to develop impactful medicines to accelerate access to innovation for patients around the world.

We are now opening this same delivery engine to the world’s most promising external science. Through SuperHighway partnerships, highly promising assets from leading biotech partners can access our development capabilities creating a true win-win ecosystem with the ultimate goal of helping more patients around the world. This is not a fee-for-service model; it is a bold new way to grow the company and expand what’s possible in oncology. This is a rare opportunity to help build something genuinely new — joining a high-caliber, agile team at the leading edge of clinical development innovation. If you are energized by building, by challenging the status quo, and by making a real impact on patients’ lives, this is where you belong.

The position contributes to the overall partnership program strategy and driving its vision and mission. Leveraging deep therapeutic and functional area expertise, the Portfolio and Program Management Lead is accountable for the lifecycle management of drug development and commercialization in the partnership program. The Lead provides leadership for global product development strategies within the partnership program, establishes clear processes for team management and communication, drives strategic team decision-making and delivery of team goals and objectives. Lead process improvement initiatives and optimize team efficiency, quality, and performance, collaborate within and outside the partnership program teams to deliver on commitments to the organization and to patients.

This role helps deliver the partnership studies that run on our Clinical SuperHighway, supporting seamless onboarding and high-quality execution of external partner projects in close partnership with the execution functions.

Essential Functions of the Job:

  • Develop, validate, and maintain project plans, schedules, and lead team planning session including develop team charter, define project scope, and ensure global cross-functional alignment.
  • Support the partnership program leadership on developing goals and operational KPIs.
  • Plan, track, and manage project milestones, goals, KPIs, project budget, dependencies, and critical path.
  • Implement good project and risk management practices.
  • Liaise with internal and external collaborators to deliver high quality work product, presentations, etc.
  • Lead process improvement initiatives, e.g., headcount and budget planning, budget change control, program management dashboards and reports, risk management, etc., and continuous identify any opportunities for improvement.
  • Assume the responsibilities and leadership of independently providing alliance management for drug development partners and assure smooth external collaboration.
  • Consult with Advisory Committee for relevant topics and incorporate the ideas into strategy and execution if appropriate.
  • Track project status, goals, operational KPIs, and enforce quality KPIs.
  • Ensure appropriate systems and technologies deployed in the partnership program and well interfaced with Global R&D.
  • Champions a global mindset and approach to foster collaboration and consistency across the organization.
  • Organize and coordinate core team meetings and facilitate the meetings to drive efficient discussion, alignment and decision making.
  • Understand competitors’ movements and market intelligence and be able to translate the insight and acumen into developing strategies.
  • Participate company-wise standard discussion, finalization, and implementation.
  • Manage the governance process for the partnership program.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities: N/A (individual contributor role; no direct reports).

Computer Skills: Skilled in Microsoft Office Suite

Other Qualifications:

  • Solid knowledge and expertise of managing scaled and complex global portfolio and programs
  • Good understanding of worldwide clinical trial expertise and best practices
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build and maintain positive work relationships to effectively interface at all levels across the organization
  • PMP certification a plus
  • Experience in Oncology/Hematology drug development is preferred
  • Fluent in written and verbal English.
  • Proven ability to make sound judgement and decisions. Possess the ability to quickly assess problems/situations and provide effective resolution/solution
  • Detail-oriented without losing sight of the big picture

Travel: Up to 20%. Ability to travel domestically and internationally.

Education Required:

Master’s degree (PhD preferred) with 10+ years’ experience in drug development or commercial within academia, consulting, pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry. 5+ years in leadership roles in a multicultural & international (global) portfolio environment a plus.

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
  • Financial Excellence
  • Communicates with Clarity
Salary Range: $214,500.00 - $284,500.00 annually

jobs.excerpt: We’re growing fast, and our Talent Team needs to grow with us.
jobs.description:
We’re growing fast, and our Talent Team needs to grow with us.

We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist who gets curious when a profile is hard to find. Someone who enjoys digging into unfamiliar talent markets, figuring out where the right people are, and finding creative ways to reach them, whether that means a specialized industry expert or a SaaS hire.

You’re naturally curious, know how to turn an unfamiliar profile into a smart sourcing strategy, and take ownership of your pipeline from first search to signed offer. Most importantly, you want your work to have a real influence on who joins Azumuta and how we grow.

If that sounds like you, this could be your seat.

⚙️ About Azumuta

Manufacturing is going through its biggest transformation in decades, and we’re right at the center of it.

Since 2016, Azumuta has helped leading manufacturers across Europe and North America digitize their operations. Now we’re taking that further with AI that generates work instructions automatically, assists operators in real time, and removes repetitive administrative work.

We’re not simply digitizing old processes. We’re rethinking how manufacturing gets done.

And as we grow, the people we bring on board will determine how far we can take that mission. That’s where you come in.

🚀 What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own searches from the start. Get to the heart of each role, understand the recruitment priority, challenge assumptions where needed, and align with hiring managers on the candidate profile and sourcing strategy before starting your search.

  • Run the full recruitment cycle. Take ownership of sourcing, screening, interviewing, case assignments, candidate follow up, and offer negotiations. Whether you’re hiring for a highly specialized profile or a more familiar SaaS role, you bring the same level of rigor and care.

  • Create a candidate experience that feels like Azumuta. Make sure every candidate gets a transparent, engaging, and respectful experience, whether they ultimately join us or not.

  • Become a trusted partner to hiring managers. Advise them on recruitment best practices, help sharpen candidate profiles, train them in competency based interviewing, and support them in making better hiring decisions.

  • Get creative with sourcing. Use tools, networks, communities, partnerships, and your own curiosity to reach people who are not actively looking. Keep experimenting with new approaches and continuously improve how we find specialist and hard to reach talent.

  • Know your talent markets. Build an understanding of where the best candidates are, what motivates them, and how the market is evolving. Turn that knowledge into better searches and smarter hiring decisions.

  • Help build our employer brand. Contribute to national and international recruitment campaigns and initiatives that make the right people curious about Azumuta.

  • Use data to get better. Track recruitment activity and pipeline performance, identify what is and isn’t working, and turn those insights into concrete improvements.

💜 What’s In It for You

We’re a small team doing big things in a market that’s ready for change. Join us and you’ll have a real seat at the table, meaningful ownership, and the opportunity to shape the team behind Azumuta.

That means:

  • Impact from day one. The people you bring in will directly influence our growth, and your ideas will help shape how we recruit as we scale.

  • Room to build. This isn’t a role where every process has already been defined. You’ll have the freedom to experiment, improve our sourcing approach, and help build a recruitment function that can grow with the company.

  • A scale up environment with solid roots. Work in a fast paced international company where autonomy, ownership, and new ideas are genuinely encouraged.

  • A fun, ambitious team. Join colleagues who are building Azumuta’s next chapter together, with plenty of milestones and questionable dad jokes along the way.

  • A visible role in our employer brand. Represent Azumuta at events and initiatives and help strengthen our presence in the tech and manufacturing ecosystem

Requirements

🎯 You’d Be a Great Fit If You Have

  • Around 3 years of recruitment experience, with strong hands on sourcing experience and a track record of looking beyond the obvious channels.

  • Experience recruiting niche, specialist, or hard to find profiles, beyond standard SaaS or tech roles. When there’s no obvious talent pool, you know how to map the market and build a search strategy from scratch.

  • A genuine hunter mindset. You enjoy research, outreach, experimentation, and the challenge of finding someone who isn’t sitting in every recruiter’s LinkedIn search.

jobs.description:
About Accelerant

Accelerant is a data-driven risk exchange connecting underwriters of specialty insurance risk with risk capital providers. Accelerant was founded in 2018 by a group of longtime insurance industry executives and technology experts who shared a vision of rebuilding the way risk is exchanged – so that it works better, for everyone. The Accelerant risk exchange does business across more than 20 different countries and 250 specialty products, and we are proud that our insurers have been awarded an AM Best A- (Excellent) rating. For more information, please visit .

Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)

Location: Remote (flexible within U.S.)

The Role

We're building business solutions across the enterprise at Accelerant, and we need quality engineering to scale and keep up. You'll help drive the test automation strategy and implementation across our enterprise stack: Salesforce, MuleSoft, D365 and Reporting. You are a key decider about what gets automated, how it gets covered, and what gets pushed back on engineering.

We need someone who can scale it, harden it, expand its reach into systems that have never had real QA coverage, and build modern, AI-assisted QA tooling that lets our team expand its impact.

You'll partner closely with engineering, product, and business teams to identify where quality is leaking, expand automation breadth and depth, and build specialized QA agents that reduce the manual toil. You own end-to-end delivery of the test automation function.

This Is a High-Autonomy, High-Impact Role for Someone Who:

  • Sees a flaky test or a coverage gap and cannot leave it alone. Excels at iterating and shipping the right framework, not the perfect one.
  • Has scaled a real test automation framework in production — not just written tests against one.
  • Has built with Playwright, modern CI, and AI coding assistants long enough to have strong opinions about what fits our needs.
  • Can prototype a QA agent in Cursor and iterate as they go.
  • Operates with autonomy, and can carry a technical discussion on framework design, test architecture, and tradeoffs.
  • Is genuinely curious about applying emerging AI to QA.

What You'll Do

Drive the test automation initiative

  • Own the test automation roadmap end to end. Set the strategy, prioritize the work, and drive execution across the team. You'll partner with QA and engineering on what we automate, how, and when.

Scale the foundational framework

  • A Playwright/JavaScript framework is already built. Take it from foundational to enterprise-grade, with a focus on performance, stability, and reusability.

Expand coverage breadth and depth

  • Push automation into areas that may not have any QA support today, and deepen regression coverage on core systems: Salesforce, MuleSoft, D365 Power Apps, D365 F&O, DCR, and Tagetik.

Implement a scalable design and review process

  • Help build the design and review process that keeps automation quality high as the suite and the team grow - test design standards, code review norms, framework contribution guidelines.

Scale test execution and reporting

  • Build the infrastructure that runs tests fast, reports results clearly, and surfaces signal over noise. Parallel execution, smart retries, actionable dashboards.

Build specialized QA agents using Cursor AI

  • Design and ship AI agents for performance testing, regression analysis, and defect triage (to name a few). Use Cursor as your build environment. Treat the agents as products solving specific problems.

Host QA agents on the AI fabric

  • Partner with the AI platform team to deploy your agents on the org's AI fabric. Make them discoverable, governed, and reusable across functions.

What You'll Bring

Must-Haves

  • Proven experience designing and scaling test automation frameworks in production.
  • Deep hands-on expertise with Playwright and modern JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Experience automating against complex enterprise SaaS - ideally Salesforce, MuleSoft, D365 (Power Apps and/or F&O).
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs and AI coding assistants - Cursor in particular. Bonus if you've built and deployed agents.

Position: Deal Execution Manager im E-Commerce M&A bei BRANDCIRCLE

Ort: 100% Remote (Meetings/Treffen im Nürnberger Office möglich, aber nicht notwendig)

Verfügbarkeit: Ab sofort

Über uns

BRANDCIRCLE ist eine aufstrebende E-Commerce M&A Beratungs-Boutique mit Fokus auf der Abwicklung von M&A-Deals für Online-Händler in der Regel im Bereich von 2-40 Millionen € Jahresumsatz.

Wir als BRANDCIRCLE übernehmen eine strategische und operative Beratertätigkeit beim Verkauf von Assets und/oder Unternehmensanteilen für E-Commerce-Unternehmer, um den höchstmöglichen Verkaufswert für unsere Kunden zu erzielen. Für unsere Alumni, also Kunden, die erfolgreich gemeinsam mit uns verkauft haben, übernehmen wir auch das Management von Zukäufen anderer Marken/Unternehmen – die Tätigkeit erstreckt sich von der Akquise, über die Verhandlung und Dokumentenprüfung bis hin zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.

Wir streben danach, unseren Kunden die bestmögliche Erfahrung mit unserer Beratung zu bieten. Dies erreichen wir durch exzellente Ergebnisse im Unternehmensverkauf und um dies zu schaffen, ist für uns eine vertrauensvolle, offene und zuverlässige Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden von zentraler Bedeutung.

Unser Prinzip: Built by Operators. Executed by Dealmakers. Wir sind keine klassische M&A-Boutique – wir sind Unternehmer, die selbst Marken aufgebaut und verkauft haben. Wir verstehen KPIs, Unit Economics und Pain Points unserer Kunden, weil wir sie selbst erlebt haben. Brandcircle versteht sich als Ökosystem, das Qualität und Kapital systematisch zusammenführt.

Aktuell suchen wir einen Deal Execution Manager (m/w/d), der unsere M&A-Mandate operativ orchestriert und unseren Deal Lead Lucas Beier substantiell entlastet – ohne dabei Geschwindigkeit oder Deal-Qualität zu verlieren.

Du bist der operative Motor jedes Mandats: Du treibst mehrere Live-Deals parallel durch unser D4U-EXIT-System (Optimierungsprozess, Datenraum, Investorenbriefing, Angebotsverhandlung, LOI, Due Diligence, Signing/Migration), steuerst unsere Inhouse-Teams (Finance, Ops, Sales, Marketing/PR) aus und stellst sicher, dass keine Bälle fallen. Strategie, Verhandlungsdesign und finale Entscheidungen bleiben bei Lucas und Christoph – Du bist die Execution-Schicht dazwischen, mit klarem Wachstumspfad in Richtung eigenständiger Mandatsführung.

KI ist dabei für uns kein Buzzword – sie ist unser operativer Hebel. Wir arbeiten täglich mit Claude, n8n und Make, um M&A-Prozesse zu automatisieren, die andere noch manuell abarbeiten. Von KI-gestützter Käufer-Recherche über automatisierte Financial-Analysen bis hin zu intelligenten Outreach-Sequenzen – wir denken Automatisierung in jeder Phase unseres D4U-EXIT-Systems. Wir suchen jemanden, der diesen Hebel nicht nur akzeptiert, sondern aktiv für sich nutzt.

Wir sind ein erfolgsorientiertes Unternehmen und folgen dem Prinzip „Hire for attitude, train for skill" und bilden Dich in allen relevanten Dingen aus. Von Vorteil ist es, wenn Du die gleiche Sprache sprichst wie wir – und zwar nicht nur „E-Commerce M&A", sondern auch fließend Claude. In unserem Arbeitsalltag sind wir von der Lösung zu 100% Remote arbeiten zu können überzeugt und garantieren somit eine hohe Flexibilität!

Wenn Du Lust hast, M&A-Mandate operativ zu treiben, mit KI in jeder Phase echte Hebel zu setzen und vollen Einsatz für unsere Kunden zu geben, dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! :)

Aufgaben

  • Deal-Orchestrierung über alle Phasen: Du steuerst die operative Dealabwicklung über alle Phasen unseres D4U-EXIT-Systems – von Optimierungsprozess, Datenraum-Setup und Investorenbriefing über Angebotsverhandlung, LOI, Due Diligence bis zu Signing und Migration. Du sorgst dafür, dass Schnittstellen sauber laufen und keine Themen verschleppt werden.
  • Mandanten- und Käuferkontakt: Du begleitest Mandanten- und Käufergespräche, übernimmst eigenständige Statusupdates und treibst mit konsequentem Push und Reminder-Management Käufer und deren Teams durch die DD. Im ersten Jahr in Co-Lead mit Lucas, mit wachsender Eigenverantwortung bis hin zur eigenständigen Übernahme kompletter Mandate.
  • Zeit- und Projektmanagement: Du taktest die Mandate zeitlich ein, trackst Meilensteine und koordinierst im Backend über Monday und unseren Performance-Tracker. Pünktlichkeit, Verbindlichkeit und sauberes Tracking sind Dein Standard.
  • Steuerung der Inhouse-Teams: Du steuerst unsere spezialisierten Fachteams (Finance & Tax, E-Commerce & Operations, Deal-Management, Marketing & PR) modular pro Mandat aus.
  • KI-gestütztes Arbeiten: Du nutzt aktiv unseren internen AI-Stack (Claude, GPT n8n, Make, etc.) zur Effizienzsteigerung Deiner eigenen Deal-Workflows. Du arbeitest Dich über KI-aufbereitete Wissensbestände und Aufzeichnungen schnell in unsere Systeme ein und denkst Workflows proaktiv weiter.
  • Unterlagen & Verhandlungsbegleitung: Du bereitest Käuferangebote auf und vergleichst sie, begleitest LOI- und Kaufvertrags-Verhandlungen und unterstützt das Käufermanagement und die Einwandbehandlung in der Due Diligence.

Qualifikation

Hard Skills:

  • Erste M&A-Berührung: ein abgeschlossenes M&A-Praktikum oder eine erste Festanstellung mit Deal-Bezug reicht aus. Grundbegriffe und Prozesslogik (LOI, DD, SPA, Datenraum) müssen sitzen.
  • Sehr hohe Tool- und KI-Affinität: schnelle Einarbeitung in Monday, Google Workspace, Loom, Performance-Tracker und unseren AI-Stack (Claude, n8n, Make). Eigenständige Nutzung von KI für Recherche, Aufbereitung und Workflow-Automation – keine Berührungsängste.
  • Nice-to-Have: E-Commerce-Domänenkenntnis (Amazon FBA, Shopify, D2C, TACOS/ROAS, Sellerboard, Supply-Chain-Mechanik) – falls nicht vorhanden, bauen wir das im Onboarding über externen E-Commerce-Kurs und internen Hardbeat Sales- und Marketing-Kurs auf.
  • Nice-to-Have: 1 bis 4 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einem deal-nahen Umfeld – klassische Quellen: M&A-Boutique, Investment Banking, Big4 Transaction Services, FBA-Aggregator, Strategy Consulting, Founders Associate / Chief of Staff oder Investment Manager bei einem E-Commerce-Investor.
  • Nice-to-Have: vertiefte M&A-Erfahrung mit deutscher LOI-, SPA- und APA-Vertragslogik sowie erste Einblicke in die E-Commerce-Investorenszene (strategische Käufer, FBA-Aggregatoren, Family Offices, kleinere PE-Häuser).
  • Erfahrung mit Projektmanagement-Tools (Monday, Notion, Asana o.ä.)
  • Deutschkenntnisse: Muttersprachler
  • Englischkenntnisse: Fließend

Soft Skills:

  • Sehr hohe Selbstorganisation: Du trackst mehrere Live-Deals parallel, ohne dass Bälle fallen. Pünktlichkeit und Verbindlichkeit sind für Dich nicht verhandelbar.
  • Ausgeprägter Kommunikationswille: aktives Status-Reporting, proaktives Eskalieren, sauberer schriftlicher und mündlicher Ausdruck. Du hältst Mandanten, Käufer und das interne Team transparent auf Stand.
  • Nüchtern und deal-erhaltend: Du sorgst strukturell dafür, dass Deals zustande kommen, statt um den letzten Cent zu feilschen. Du darfst bewusst etwas defensiver agieren als Lucas – Information auffangen, Lucas macht im Anschluss als Senior den Extra-Push.
  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe, um Dich in komplexe Deal-Konstellationen, Käufer-Logiken und M&A-Themen einzudenken
  • Offener und vertrauensvoller Umgang und hohes Maß an Loyalität – Du arbeitest direkt mit Mandanten an einem der wichtigsten Themen ihres unternehmerischen Lebens
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Organisationstalent (auch bei der gleichzeitigen Steuerung mehrerer Projekte)
  • Hohes Durchhaltevermögen, Ehrgeiz und Selbstbewusstsein
  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe, um sich in komplexe Business-Prozesse und M&A-Themen einzudenken
  • Positive Ausstrahlung und Grundhaltung zum Leben
  • Bereitschaft, wenn notwendig, die Extra-Meile zu gehen

FAZIT: Wir suchen Menschen und keine Abschlüsse

Benefits

  • Einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns und wir mit ihr wachsen.
  • Tolle Arbeitsatmosphäre: Der Umgang untereinander ist sehr kollegial und familiär. Wir ziehen alle am gleichen Strang und motivieren uns gegenseitig Bestleistungen zu erzielen und persönlich zu wachsen.

Innovative Network of Knowledge is a dynamic and rapidly growing company in an emerging space of innovation in education. Our passion is to change education forever for the K-12 students (online) we serve. We are changing the way children learn and apply knowledge in the real world. Through our Project Based approach, supported by personal Educational Concierges, we strengthen the whole child through their educational experience. Through synchronous and asynchronous opportunities, co-teaching and workshop labs, our students are immersed and challenged in a way not experienced in today’s educational landscape. In addition, staff and students will take part in weekly programs that promote character and citizenship opportunities to grow not only as a school but also as a community at large. We believe that each employee and the students we serve become part of our family and will be engaged, excited, and prepared for all that the future holds.

Our Focus
Innovative Network of Knowledge seeks to change education forever through innovation and technology. We offer a well of knowledge, a spring of possibilities and a place where your family becomes part of ours.

Key Benefits:
• Educational Concierge: Every family has access to a dedicated Educational Concierge to assist with enrollment, course planning and ongoing academic guidance, ensuring each student finds their unique path to success.

  • Community-Focused Learning: Our programs are structured to foster collaboration and connection, building confidence and social skills even within a virtual setting.

Teachers will create robust and rigorous lessons based on Project Based best practice and teach synchronously and asynchronously during the week. Teachers will collaborate with colleagues and also Co-Teach in our PBL afternoon Work Labs to engage students in real world applications and help learning come alive for every student we serve. Teachers will attend and participate in weekly PLCs, regular staff meetings, and continuous professional development as planned by the leadership. Teachers will work inside and outside the school community to promote the school’s mission and vision while fostering a positive environment for students and maintaining a strong public image for the institution.

This position will report to the principal and will work closely with a team of teachers to coordinate the forward growth and development of the students we serve as well as create new pathways and opportunities for the school’s growth.

Academics:

• Oversee the learning process, implement enrichments and remediation as needed. Follows all required IEP/504/GT/Special Program requirements.
• Ensures high-quality instruction across all subject areas.
Learning Environment

In order to do this, we must remove old barriers of stoic classroom environments and encourage exploration and the innovation that brings with it the aspirations to become more year over year for BOTH the teacher and the students.
• Building a collaborative and positive work environment amongst colleagues.

• Overseeing student activities, clubs, and extracurricular programs.

Student Engagement & Attendance:

• Communicate promptly with students and families regarding attendance concerns or disengagement.
• Implement strategies to foster student connection and community in a virtual setting.
Collaboration & Teamwork:
• Collaborate regularly with grade-level teams, instructional coaches, and leadership to plan, reflect, and improve instructional practices.
• Participate in virtual staff meetings, trainings, and planning sessions.
Personalized Learning & Differentiation:
• Utilize student performance data to personalize instruction and differentiate learning pathways.
• Support students in setting academic goals and developing self-directed learning skills.
Compliance & Documentation (Specific to Online/Private Schools):
• Maintain accurate records of student attendance, engagement, communication logs, and intervention efforts.

Professional Responsibilities:

Administrative Duties:

Required Qualifications:

• Ability to travel as needed for program integrity and growth

    • Knowledge of education regulations and policies in Texas.

Preferred Qualifications:

    • Understanding of private school culture and mission

Other duties as assigned

jobs.title: Senior BI & Marketing Analyst
jobs.excerpt: PeopleFinders. com, the premier online service for consumers to locate, contact and verify people and businesses.
jobs.description:
PeopleFinders.com, the premier online service for consumers to locate, contact and verify people and businesses. Over the past couple of decades the Company has quietly become one of the largest owners of public records data in the country, distributing its products over a vast network of websites.

PeopleFinders | Remote | Reports to Performance Marketing Leadership

Job Purpose

The Senior BI & Marketing Analyst is the company’s hands-on business intelligence resource, responsible for turning data from across the business into timely, accurate reporting and actionable insight — with a particular focus on performance marketing. This role operates at two altitudes: partnering with marketing leadership to assist in planning what the business needs from its data at a high level, and then personally executing the analysis, reporting, and dashboard development to deliver it. We’re looking for a motivated self-starter who ramps quickly on new businesses, industries, and datasets, sets a high bar for accuracy, and is equally comfortable presenting to executives and writing the SQL themselves.

Salary - $110k - $120k

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Marketing & Business Analytics

  • Analyze customer acquisition performance across paid search, display, affiliate, and organic channels — spend efficiency, conversion rates, cost per acquisition, and cost per subscriber — and recommend optimizations to the performance marketing team.
  • Build and maintain reporting on subscription funnel economics: trial starts, trial-to-paid conversion, rebill/retention, churn, and customer lifetime value by channel and campaign.
  • Analyze A/B and pricing test results to guide decisions on page content, UX, offers, and pricing.
  • Investigate anomalies in traffic, conversion, and revenue data; distinguish real business changes from tracking or attribution artifacts before findings reach stakeholders.

Reporting & BI Development

  • Retrieve and aggregate data from multiple sources (web analytics, ad platforms, billing/subscription systems, internal databases) into clear, actionable reporting for stakeholders at all levels.
  • Design, build, and maintain automated dashboards and reporting solutions in our BI platform (Domo), migrating existing manual and legacy reporting into governed, automated pipelines.
  • Automate and optimize existing manual data workflows, reducing time-to-insight and error risk.
  • Partner with leadership to define key metrics, KPIs, and dashboards that measure business performance; maintain clear metric definitions and a single source of truth.

Collaboration & Planning

  • Plan the reporting and analytics roadmap at a high level with business owners, then prioritize and execute the work individually and with BI contractors.
  • Work with cross-functional teams (marketing, product, engineering, finance) and external agency partners on day-to-day execution of analytics projects and initiatives.
  • Over time, coordinate work with BI contractors supporting platform development, reviewing output for quality and consistency.

Basic Qualifications & Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in business intelligence, marketing analytics, or a comparable analytical role.
  • Strong SQL skills, with experience querying and aggregating large datasets from multiple sources; experience with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake preferred).
  • Hands-on experience building dashboards and automated reporting in a modern BI platform; Domo experience is required (Power BI, Tableau, or Looker also relevant).
  • Direct experience supporting a performance marketing or growth team (paid search, display, affiliates).
  • Experience with subscription or trial-based D2C business models and their economics (LTV, ROAS, churn, cohort analysis).
  • Advanced Excel skills, including complex functions, pivot tables, and linked, multi-source workbooks.
  • Demonstrated ability to ramp quickly on a new business, industry, and unfamiliar datasets — investigating, mastering, and documenting them with minimal guidance.
  • Ability to operate at both altitudes: shape analytics priorities with leadership, then personally deliver the work end to end.
  • Strong communication skills — able to present complex quantitative findings in a simple, intuitive format to executive audiences.
  • Self-starter with high standards for quality, performance, and accuracy.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Google Analytics (GA4), UTM-based attribution, and combining web analytics with internal data.
  • Experience working with billing/subscription platform data (e.g., Recurly, Chargebee, Stripe).
  • Experience analyzing A/B tests with tools such as VWO, Optimizely, or similar.
  • Experience collaborating with external media agencies or BI contractors.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or equivalent work experience.

Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance

jobs.title: Claims Counsel, Management Liability
jobs.excerpt: Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.
jobs.description:
Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.

Brown & Brown is seeking a Claims Counsel, Management Liability to join our growing team!

    

The Claims Counsel's primary function is to independently manage a portfolio of complex Management Liability claims, including Directors & Officers Liability, Employment Practices Liability, Fiduciary Liability, Crime, and related financial lines claims involving private companies and nonprofit organizations.


The successful candidate will work closely with underwriting, carrier partners, brokers, insureds, and defense counsel to deliver superior claims outcomes while supporting the strategic growth of Nexus's Management Liability portfolio. This role requires deep technical expertise, sound business judgment, strong relationship management skills, and the ability to balance legal, coverage, financial, customer service, and portfolio considerations in claims decision-making.

How You Will Contribute:  

Claims Management and Coverage Analysis

  • Independently manage a portfolio of complex and high-severity Management Liability claims.
  • Analyze policy coverage and prepare reservation of rights letters, coverage position letters, and declination letters.
  • Conduct detailed factual, legal, financial, and coverage analyses to evaluate liability, damages, and exposure.
  • Establish and maintain appropriate claim reserves within delegated authority and seek additional authority when required.
  • Evaluate settlement opportunities and participate in mediations, settlement conferences, and other dispute resolution proceedings.
  • Exercise sound judgment on complex coverage and litigation issues while maintaining consistency with claims handling guidelines and business objectives.

Litigation Management

  • Direct litigation involving insured organizations and individual directors, officers, trustees, and executives.
  • Retain, manage, and evaluate defense counsel and coverage counsel.
  • Review and approve litigation budgets, monitor legal spend, and negotiate alternative fee arrangements when appropriate.
  • Develop and implement effective litigation and resolution strategies.

Portfolio and Business Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to underwriting regarding claims trends, emerging risks, coverage issues, and portfolio performance.
  • Partner with underwriting teams to identify opportunities for product enhancement and improved risk selection.
  • Analyze claims trends and portfolio data to identify emerging exposures and provide actionable business insights.
  • Prepare timely, accurate reporting for carrier partners and reinsurers and participate in stewardship discussions and portfolio reviews.
  • Demonstrate a balanced approach that considers legal exposure, coverage intent, customer experience, broker relationships, and portfolio impact when making claims decisions.

Broker and Market Engagement

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with retail and wholesale brokers, insureds, carrier partners, and defense counsel.
  • Participate in broker stewardship meetings, claim reviews, underwriting roundtables, and market-facing presentations as needed.
  • Represent Nexus professionally in interactions with brokers, insureds, carrier partners, counsel, and industry stakeholders.

Leadership and Operational Excellence

  • Serve as a technical resource and mentor to less experienced claims professionals.
  • Participate in claims audits, quality reviews, training initiatives, and process improvement projects.
  • Support strategic initiatives designed to enhance claims operations and service delivery.
  • Embrace claims technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency, consistency, and claim outcomes.
  • Ensure compliance with delegated authority agreements, carrier guidelines, service standards, and applicable regulations.

Skills & Experience to be Successful: 

  • Juris Doctor (JD) degree and active bar membership.
  • Minimum 7-10 years of experience handling Management Liability claims.
  • Demonstrated expertise in private company D&O, nonprofit organization liability, EPL, and Fiduciary Liability coverage analysis.
  • Significant experience drafting complex reservation of rights letters, coverage position letters, and declination letters.
  • Significant experience handling shareholder and ownership disputes involving closely held entities; governance and executive liability disputes; regulatory and governmental investigations; and bankruptcy, insolvency, trustee, receiver, creditor, and related executive liability claims.
  • Strong understanding of Management Liability policy forms, endorsements, and coverage structures.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage high-severity and complex claims.
  • Strong analytical, negotiation, litigation management, financial analysis, and relationship management skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Strong business and strategic decision-making capabilities.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and claims management systems.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a small, collaborative, high-performing team consistent with company values.

Preferred

  • Experience handling claims involving private equity-backed, venture-backed, founder-led, or closely held organizations.
  • Experience within an MGA, specialty insurer, E&S carrier, or Management Liability insurance carrier.
  • Experience operating under delegated claims authority.
  • Experience presenting claims trends, portfolio analytics, and emerging risks to senior management, underwriters, brokers, and carrier partners.
  • CPCU, RPLU, SCLA, ARC, or similar industry designation.

Pay Range

$150,000 - $160,000 Annual

The pay range provided above is made in good faith and based on our lowest and highest annual salary or hourly rate paid for the role and takes into account years of experience required, geography, and/or budget for the role.

Teammate Benefits & Total Well-Being

We go beyond standard benefits, focusing on the total well-being of our teammates, including:

  • Health Benefits: Medical/Rx, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Disability Insurance
  • Financial Benefits: ESPP; 401k; Student Loan Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement
  • Mental Health & Wellness: Free Mental Health & Enhanced Advocacy Services
  • Beyond Benefits: Paid Time Off, Holidays, Preferred Partner Discounts and more.

Not reflective of all benefits. Enrollment waiting periods or eligibility criteria may apply to certain benefits. Benefit details and offerings may vary for subsidiary entities or in specific geographic locations.


Recruiting Vendor Disclosure Statement

Brown & Brown does not accept unsolicited resumes from external recruiters, recruitment vendors or employment agencies ("Recruiting Vendors"). Recruiting Vendors must have a valid written agreement and received prior written authorization from an authorized Brown & Brown representative before submitting candidates for any publicly posted role. Critically, you'll act as a bridge between the architectural vision and the hands-on engineering work that brings these solutions to life.

Technical Requirements Definition and Management

Cloud-Native SaaS Architecture Design

AI-Driven Medical Imaging Platform Development

  • Design disaster recovery and business continuity solutions for critical clinical trial data.

  • Ensure compliance with medical data privacy regulations across multiple jurisdictions.

Database & Data Architecture for Medical Imaging

  • Design high-performance database architectures optimized for medical imaging metadata and AI model outputs.

  • Perform analysis of business features to create and maintain both logical and physical data models.

  • Design solutions which enable the storage, analysis, access, and movement of large-scale medical imaging datasets.

Performance Optimization & Monitoring

Technical Leadership

Innovation

Other

jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Product team

The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.

The role

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join us in supporting our post-purchase experience and international expansion. Design serves a vital role at Affirm: from building narratives through data to creating products that help people make important financial decisions. As a designer, you are responsible for crafting experiences that build trust, confidence and deliver on our principles of honest, transparent financial products.

We’re at a critical inflection point in Affirm’s journey, with millions of people engaging with our products and new opportunities to expand how they use Affirm every day. We’re also growing globally, reaching new customers in new geographies every day.

This Product Designer will help shape our post-purchase experiences, as well as building the next new geographies that Affirm will expand into. You can demonstrate a breadth of design experience leveraging your ability to create delightful experiences that simplify our customers’ payment management experience through Affirm as well as contributing to our wider international expansion strategy. You’ll partner well with design leadership, design research, and content design. You’ll work end-to-end, from contributing towards Design and Product vision to delivering class leading design. You are able to work closely with Product and Engineering to tailor unique customer experiences for our merchants & consumers while ensuring cohesion to the core Affirm experience - championing our customers needs no matter where their journey starts.

What You'll Do

  • Lead end-to-end design for key initiatives within our UK and international experiences, as well as our post purchase experiences globally, across App and Web. You’ll be driving from discovery through to delivery and iteration—achieving meaningful customer and business outcomes.

  • Own complex flows and ambiguous problem spaces, defining clear problem statements, success metrics, and design direction.

  • Partner closely with product, engineering, and data to make informed trade-offs and deliver intuitive, high-quality experiences.

  • Balance speed and quality, making pragmatic decisions while contributing to a cohesive product experience.

  • Use research, data, and experimentation to inform decisions and continuously improve outcomes.

  • Contribute to design systems and patterns, strengthening consistency and scalability across your area.

  • Facilitate alignment and decision-making, ensuring teams move forward with clarity.

  • Support and mentor other designers, helping raise the quality of work across the team.

What we look for

  • Strong Craft & Execution: You consistently deliver polished, thoughtful interaction and visual design with high attention to detail.

  • Product Thinking: You balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints to make sound design decisions and improve end-to-end experiences.

  • Ownership & Initiative: You take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive work forward with minimal oversight.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: You build strong partnerships, communicate clearly, and help teams align on decisions and trade-offs.

  • Data-Informed Decision Making: You use research, experimentation, and analytics to guide your work and iterate toward better outcomes.

  • Team-Level Influence: You’re a trusted design partner within your area, contributing to direction and improving how the team works.

  • Growth & Adaptability: You seek feedback, continuously improve your craft, and leverage modern tools—including AI—to accelerate your workflow.

  • Tools & Experience: Proficiency with modern design and collaboration tools (Figma, G Suite, Notion, etc.).

  • 5+ years of product design experience or equivalent practical experience.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • You’ll design financial products that genuinely help people.

  • You’ll work on high-impact experiences used by millions of customers.

  • You’ll join a team that values craft, collaboration, and thoughtful iteration.

  • You’ll have the opportunity to grow your scope, influence, and leadership over time.

This is a remote-first position based in the UK with the option to work from our London office for candidates who prefer an office environment.

Compensation & Benefits

Base Pay Grade: L

Equity Grade: UK 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure based on a variety of factors, including location, experience, and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness, and tech spending, and benefits including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental, and vision for you and your dependents. In addition, employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc.

GBR base pay range per year: £101,000 - 149,000

Location: Remote UK

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

jobs.description:
Who are we?
Hi! 👋 We are Ravelin! We're a fraud detection company using advanced machine learning and network analysis technology to solve big problems. Our goal is to make online transactions safer and help our clients feel confident serving their customers.
And we have fun in the meantime! We are a friendly bunch and pride ourselves in having a strong culture and adhering to our values of empathy, ambition, unity and integrity. We really value work/life balance and we embrace a flat hierarchy structure company-wide. Join us and you’ll learn fast about cutting-edge tech and work with some of the brightest and nicest people around - check out our Glassdoor reviews.
If this sounds like your cup of tea, we would love to hear from you! For more information check out our blog to see if you would like to help us prevent crime and protect the world's biggest online businesses.
The Role
We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to join the Integrations team. This role will involve line managing other Project Managers, driving process improvements and ambitious goals in the team, and contributing to the delivery of successful client integrations.

Within our Integrations team, the Project Managers work alongside our Integration Engineers, with individual pairs assigned to a client integration project. The Project Manager’s focus is on understanding the client’s objectives and guiding them through the process from integration kick-off to actively using the Ravelin product(s). Your focus will be mostly on coaching others to deliver, more than leading day-to-day client project activities.

In this role, you will also be working closely with many other teams within Ravelin, bringing everything together for a successful outcome for our clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a leader in establishing and developing best practices for Project Managers within the Integrations team, to ensure we continue to strive for high quality and effective integrations.
  • Support the Director of Integrations on initiatives around process improvement, change management, and the wider company goals, leading some initiatives and contributing to others.
  • Line manage a number of Project Managers, supporting and coaching them in their role.
  • Contribute to technical and business integrations with clients. This may be via other Project Managers, or by directly running client projects.
  • Deliver operational excellence, as part of overseeing a collection of projects. Anticipate potential issues and dependencies, and highlight or escalate project risks where appropriate.
  • Develop strong working relationships with our clients. This may include chairing some day-to-day client-facing meetings, but also helping to resolve complex client requirements and bringing any escalations to a calm conclusion.
  • Ensure excellent time management of your own tasks, but also assisting others to prioritise, to set goals and to set expectations with clients.
  • Maintain all project documentation, and actively promote knowledge sharing within the Integration team, and wider Ravelin teams.
  • Proactively engage with the Product team, sharing feature suggestions and interesting scenarios from client conversations.

Requirements

  • 5 or more years of line management experience.
  • Project management experience in a technical or integrations environment, with exposure to complex products or solutions.
  • A track record of process improvement, and experience in instigating change within a team and across teams.
  • Exceptional communication skills – both internally and client-facing.
  • The ability to direct and lead others confidently, and comfortable having difficult conversations when needed.
  • Analytical with great attention to detail.
  • Pragmatic problem solver and solutions-oriented.
  • Strong commercial awareness

Benefits

  • Flexible Working Hours & Remote-First Environment — Work when and where you’re most productive, with flexibility and support.
  • Comprehensive BUPA Health Insurance — Stay covered with top-tier medical care for your peace of mind.
  • £1,000 Annual Wellness and Learning Budget — Prioritise your health, well-being and learning needs with funds for fitness, mental health, and more.
  • Monthly Wellbeing and Learning Day — Take every last Friday of the month off to recharge or learn something new, up to you.
  • 25 Days Holiday + Bank Holidays + 1 Extra Cultural Day — Enjoy generous time off to rest, travel, or celebrate what matters to you.
  • Mental Health Support via Spill — Access professional mental health services when you need them.
  • Aviva Pension Scheme — Plan for the future with our pension program.
  • Ravelin Gives Back — Join monthly charitable donations and volunteer opportunities to make a positive impact.
  • Fortnightly Randomised Team Lunches — Connect with teammates from across the company over in person or remote lunches every other week on us!
  • Cycle-to-Work Scheme — Save on commuting costs while staying active.
  • BorrowMyDoggy Access — Love dogs? Spend time with a furry friend through this unique perk.
  • Weekly Board Game Nights & Social Budget — Unwind with weekly board games or plan your own socials, supported by a company budget.

*Job offers may be withdrawn if candidates do not meet our pre-employment checks: unspent criminal convictions, employment verification, and right to work.*

jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

Instacart’s product and technology partnerships — spanning logistics, retail technology, and enterprise products — are a core lever for how we build and grow. But as our ambitions scale into new product areas and international markets, the function needs more than experienced deal-makers. It needs a senior leader who can set the multi-year vision, personally own the most consequential relationships, and shape how Instacart decides what to build versus buy versus partner. Without this person, we risk reactive partnership decisions, misalignment between partnerships and product strategy, and missed first-mover opportunities in markets where speed matters. We’re hiring a Director of Product Partnerships to lead the team and function at the highest level — influencing build-buy-partner tradeoffs with senior leadership, taking first-of-a-kind bets from 0 to 1, and making Instacart one of the most sought-after partners in grocery technology.

What you’ll cook up in your first year.

  • Instacart has a clear, credible multi-year partnership strategy across Logistics, Retail Technology, and Enterprise — one that leadership has bought into and that's actively shaping which product bets we pursue versus partner for.
  • At least one first-of-a-kind deal — in a new product area or international market — has gone from concept to signed to launched, with a playbook behind it that the team can repeat.
  • The partnerships team is operating at a higher level — Senior Managers and Managers have clearer ownership, stronger frameworks for deal evaluation and partner performance, and a leader who’s actively developing them for what comes next.
  • Product and Engineering leadership treat this person as a genuine strategic partner — not just a deal-closer — because they’ve visibly influenced roadmap decisions and brought external perspective into how we build.
  • Instacart’s most critical external partners — at the C-suite and executive level — have a named senior relationship owner who shows up with authority, earns trust, and surfaces the opportunities that matter most to the business.

The secret ingredients we’re looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 15+ years of experience in business development, product partnerships, or strategic alliances in technology or closely adjacent industries, with end-to-end ownership of complex, multi-stakeholder deals from sourcing through launch.
  • Demonstrated experience building and leading high-performing partnerships teams, including managing managers and structuring a function for scale.
  • Proven track record of closing complex, non-standard technology or strategic partnership agreements — including first-of-a-kind deals — with C-suite or executive-level counterparts.
  • Experience serving as a true strategic partner to Product and Engineering: influencing roadmap and build-buy-partner decisions, not just executing alongside them.
  • Strong financial and analytical skills, including business case development to evaluate partnership economics and communicate ROI to senior leadership.
  • Comfortable operating without a roadmap — brings clarity and direction to a team even when the path forward isn’t obvious.

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience with software and/or hardware partnerships across retail, grocery, in-store technology, e-commerce, loyalty, POS, or adjacent ecosystems.
  • Experience with international product partnerships, particularly in EMEA markets.
  • Background in management consulting, investment banking, or corporate development.
  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree.

The API & SDK team serves as the embedded technical experts for Zoom's most demanding enterprise accounts, covering the full lifecycle of SDK and API integration challenges across Video, Native, Mobile, and CoBrowse SDKs. We collaborate closely with iOS, Web, and CoBrowse engineering alongside TAMs, CSMs, and Solutions Engineers to ensure end-to-end issue ownership and resolution. Our mission is to keep Zoom's most strategic customers running and make their developers' lives easier.

  • Own end-to-end technical support for enterprise customers integrating Zoom's Video SDK (Web, iOS, Android), Meeting SDK, Native SDK, Mobile SDK, and CoBrowse SDK into their products.

  • Lead technical troubleshooting calls with customer engineering teams to diagnose issues, provide workarounds, and coordinate fixes with Zoom SDK engineering.

  • 5+ years of experience in developer advocacy, solutions engineering, or developer relations, with a focus on API/SDK integration, troubleshooting, or customer enablement
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python, with comfort reading and debugging code written by others
  • Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, OAuth 2.0 (Server-to-Server and Authorization Code), webhooks, and API rate-limit patterns
  • Hands-on experience integrating or troubleshooting client-side SDKs (Web, iOS, or Android); experience with real-time communication SDKs such as WebRTC, SIP, or SRTP is a plus

jobs.description:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit to learn more.

About the Role:

As Director, Security Compliance and Trust, you will build and lead the function that earns and sustains customer, regulator, and partner confidence in Motive. Reporting to the CISO, you will own governance, risk and compliance; audit and certification across ISO 27001/27701, SOC 1 and SOC 2, PCI DSS and the path to FedRAMP; privacy and data protection; customer trust; security policy; training and human risk; and AI governance. You will partner closely with Legal, Engineering, Product, IT, Finance, Sales and Customer Success to make compliance a business enabler rather than a tax.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will lead a small, senior, globally distributed team — and you will also write policy, design controls, sit in audit fieldwork, and answer the hardest customer questions yourself. We expect this function to be built AI-first, with automation designed into the operating model from day one rather than added to a traditional GRC team later. Global expansion is central to the role: Motive is growing into Canada, the EU, Mexico and South America, and you will be the person who makes those markets enterable — mapping obligations before Sales arrives and building controls that satisfy multiple jurisdictions at once.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the compliance, privacy and trust function end-to-end — org design, hiring, and global team development — and act as Motive's senior authority on the control environment, deciding which frameworks we adopt and where we accept versus remediate risk
  • Build a single integrated control framework that maps once to many across ISO 27001/27701, SOC 1 and SOC 2, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, GDPR and CCPA/CPRA, so evidence is collected once rather than once per framework or once per country
  • Own the annual audit calendar end-to-end, manage auditor and assessor relationships directly, and lead Motive's path to FedRAMP from the ground up as public sector opportunity matures
  • Own privacy compliance operations — data subject rights, DPIAs, ROPA and cross-border transfer mechanics — treating driver data as the sensitive category it is, including location history, in-cab video, telematics behavior and biometric-adjacent processing
  • Own regulatory readiness for new markets ahead of go-to-market, partnering with Engineering and Platform on data residency and regional architecture rather than solving localization with policy language
  • Be the face of Motive's security and privacy posture to customers — owning trust.gomotive.com, scaling security questionnaire and review response, and serving as the senior escalation point in enterprise deals
  • Architect the AI-first operating model for the function, personally building and iterating on evidence automation, continuous control monitoring and AI-assisted questionnaire response rather than delegating it to a tooling vendor
  • Own the security policy and standards library and its exceptions process, along with company-wide security training, phishing simulation and human risk measurement
  • Establish Motive's AI governance program across both product and internal AI use, building against ISO/IEC 42001, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and the EU AI Act

What We’re Looking For:

  • 8+ years in security compliance, GRC, privacy, audit or risk management, including 5+ years in leadership roles managing both people managers and senior individual contributors
  • Demonstrably hands-on. You have personally written the policies, designed the controls, built the control mappings, sat through fieldwork and answered the hardest customer questions yourself — recently, not a decade ago. Be prepared to walk through work you did with your own hands
  • Proven ownership of multi-framework compliance programs at scale in a cloud-native SaaS environment — ISO 27001, SOC 1 and SOC 2, and PCI DSS as core, with the judgment to run them as one program rather than three
  • Deep, operational privacy experience across GDPR and CCPA/CPRA, with hands-on ownership of DSAR operations, DPIAs, ROPA and cross-border transfer mechanics. CIPP/E, CIPP/US or CIPM is a plus, but demonstrated operational ownership matters more
  • Experience standing up compliance and privacy in new international markets, ideally including Canada, the EU, Mexico or Latin America. Familiarity with PIPEDA/Law 25, LGPD or the Mexican LFPDPPP is a strong advantage
  • Experience with FedRAMP, ideally having led an organization through authorization or Moderate/High readiness, with the appetite to build Motive's path from the ground up
  • Concrete, demonstrated use of AI to run compliance work — evidence collection, questionnaire response, control monitoring, policy drafting, audit preparation or regulatory gap analysis. We will ask what you built, what it replaced, and what it measurably changed. General enthusiasm for AI is not what we're looking for
  • Demonstrated ownership of customer-facing trust functions — security reviews, questionnaires, trust portals and enterprise escalation — and experience leading globally distributed teams across multiple timezones
  • Working fluency in AI governance frameworks and a clear point of view on governing AI without blocking its adoption
  • Experience supporting IPO readiness, SOX or equivalent regulated-environment scrutiny, and experience with sensitive personal data at scale, are both strongly preferred

Pay Transparency
Your compensation may be based on several factors, including education, work experience, and certifications. For certain roles, total compensation may include restricted stock units. Motive offers benefits including health, pharmacy, optical and dental care benefits, paid time off, sick time off, short term and long term disability coverage, life insurance as well as 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Learn more about our benefits by visitingMotive Perks & Benefits.

The compensation range for this position will depend on where you reside. For this role, the compensation range is:

United States
$225,000—$305,000 USD

Benefits

Zero commuting, zero traffic, and more time to do what you love.
