jobs.title: Principal Environment Artist - GameSim - Talent Pipeline
jobs.excerpt: GameSim is a game development studio that partners with clients to build games across PC/console and a range of art styles.
jobs.description:
GameSim is a game development studio that partners with clients to build games across PC/console and a range of art styles. We care about craftsmanship, collaboration, and shipping work we’re proud to put our names on. If you love building environments and believable spaces we’d like to meet you. Our headquarters is based in Orlando, FL!

Talent Pipeline Posting Notice
Please note that this posting is not tied to an immediate vacancy. We are proactively building a pipeline of qualified candidates in anticipation of potential hiring needs over the coming months. Applications will be reviewed and retained for future consideration as opportunities arise.

We are seeking a Principal Environment Artist to help define and elevate the quality, efficiency, and consistency of environment-art production across GameSim projects.

This is a high level senior individual-contributor position for an experienced artist who can operate at both the strategic and hands-on levels. You will create benchmark-quality work, establish practical production standards, solve complex artistic and technical problems, and provide direction to environment teams working across different projects, engines, styles, and partner studios.

You will work closely with Art Directors, project leads, Technical Art, Production, Design, Engineering, clients, and partner studios to translate creative goals into clear and achievable environment-art strategies.

This role requires strong leadership, sound judgment, clear communication, and the ability to influence teams through expertise, example, and collaboration.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you will:

  • Develop a strong understanding of GameSim’s projects, clients, production structure, and environment-art capabilities.
  • Build trust with artists, project leadership, clients, and partner studios through clear communication and reliable decision-making.
  • Create or guide the development of benchmark work that establishes a clear visual and technical quality bar.
  • Identify a meaningful artistic, technical, or workflow challenge and help implement a practical improvement.
  • Provide feedback and mentorship that improves the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of the environment team.

Responsibilities

Artistic Leadership and Execution

  • Create high-quality real-time environments, architecture, modular kits, hero assets, materials, terrain, foliage, and world-building content.
  • Produce benchmark assets and scenes that communicate expectations for composition, scale, visual hierarchy, material quality, environmental storytelling, and final polish.
  • Translate art direction, concept art, reference material, design requirements, and client feedback into clear production goals.
  • Establish environment-art strategies for modular construction, asset reuse, trim sheets, material systems, terrain, foliage, set dressing, and world building.
  • Maintain a strong hands-on contribution when establishing quality bars, validating workflows, solving difficult problems, or supporting critical deliverables.
  • Evaluate environment artwork objectively and provide specific, actionable feedback through reviews, paintovers, blockouts, reference boards, documentation, or in-engine examples.

Production and Pipeline Development

  • Partner with Art Direction, Production, and Technical Art to define environment workflows that balance visual quality, scope, schedule, and technical requirements.
  • Identify artistic, technical, and production risks early and recommend practical solutions.
  • Help teams break down broad or incomplete direction into understandable tasks, milestones, priorities, and acceptance criteria.
  • Improve environment-art pipelines through reusable workflows, templates, documentation, example assets, and production standards.
  • Support planning and estimation by evaluating asset complexity, dependencies, staffing needs, and production risks.
  • Troubleshoot challenging issues related to asset construction, materials, world building, optimization, engine implementation, or content integration.
  • Help ensure environments meet project requirements for performance, memory, streaming, draw calls, shader complexity, collision, LODs, and platform limitations.

Team and Project Influence

  • Guide environment artists across internal teams, partner studios, and external development groups.
  • Mentor senior artists and emerging leads in artistic judgment, communication, planning, review practices, and decision-making.
  • Collaborate with Art Directors to maintain a consistent visual direction across teams and deliverables.
  • Participate in client meetings, milestone reviews, art reviews, and project-planning discussions when senior environment-art representation is needed.
  • Communicate risks, tradeoffs, priorities, and recommendations clearly to artistic and non-artistic stakeholders.
  • Help align teams working across different studios, disciplines, cultures, and time zones.
  • Support prototypes, art tests, project pitches, preproduction efforts, and early pipeline development.
  • Contribute to the continued growth of GameSim’s environment-art discipline through mentorship, hiring support, portfolio reviews, documentation, and capability planning.

Requirements

  • Extensive professional experience in game development, real-time production, or a closely related field.
  • Multiple shipped games or comparable professional real-time projects.
  • A portfolio demonstrating exceptional environment-art quality and strong production judgment.
  • Expert understanding of composition, scale, proportion, visual hierarchy, shape language, material definition, lighting response, environmental storytelling, and scene cohesion.
  • Advanced experience creating modular environments, architecture, props, terrain, materials, and reusable asset systems.
  • Strong understanding of modeling, UVs, baking, texel density, trim sheets, tileable materials, decals, vertex blending, and real-time material workflows.
  • Professional experience developing environments in Unreal Engine or another modern real-time engine.
  • Strong understanding of environment optimization, including LODs, memory, streaming, draw calls, collision, shader complexity, and platform constraints.
  • Experience establishing visual benchmarks, environment pipelines, asset standards, or production workflows.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve complex artistic, technical, and production problems with limited supervision.
  • Experience guiding senior artists, leads, distributed teams, external partners, or vendors.
  • Ability to provide clear, constructive, and actionable artistic feedback.
  • Strong understanding of how to balance quality, scope, schedule, technical requirements, and available resources.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Experience collaborating with Art Direction, Production, Technical Art, Design, Engineering, Lighting, VFX, and other development disciplines.
  • Ability to adapt to different projects, visual styles, engines, pipelines, and client expectations.
  • Comfort participating in client-facing discussions and representing environment-art decisions professionally.

Tools and Technical Experience

Candidates should have advanced experience with a professional environment-art toolset. This may include:

  • Maya, Blender, 3ds Max, or a comparable 3D content-creation package
  • ZBrush or an equivalent sculpting application
  • Substance 3D Painter and Substance 3D Designer
  • Photoshop or comparable image-editing software
  • Unreal Engine 5 or another modern real-time engine
  • Perforce or another production source-control system
  • Jira, Confluence, Miro, or comparable planning and documentation tools

Expertise with every listed application is not required. We are primarily interested in candidates who demonstrate strong fundamentals, adaptability, and the ability to choose appropriate tools for the production problem.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in co-development, outsourcing, consulting, or work-for-hire game production.
  • Experience contributing to AAA PC or console titles.
  • Experience working across both realistic and stylized visual pipelines.
  • Experience supporting multiple projects or teams at a studio or discipline level.
  • Experience owning a level, biome, world region, or major environment feature from early planning through final delivery.
  • Experience with Unreal Engine systems such as World Partition, Nanite, virtual texturing, procedural content generation, landscape tools, material functions, Blueprints, or profiling tools.
  • Houdini experience involving procedural modeling, terrain generation, scattering, modular construction, or artist-facing tools.
  • Experience with foliage workflows, SpeedTree, photogrammetry, procedural generation, or organic-environment production.
  • Experience with lighting and post-processing sufficient to establish visual targets and diagnose presentation issues.
  • Familiarity with Python, editor scripting, automation, or technical-art tool development.
  • Experience contributing to project scoping, staffing recommendations, bidding, hiring, or portfolio evaluation.

Portfolio requirements

Your portfolio must demonstrate:

  • High-quality real-time environments with strong composition, scale, material definition, environmental storytelling, and scene cohesion.
  • Work presented in a commercial, proprietary, or modern real-time engine.
  • Clear explanations of your individual contribution, responsibilities, workflow, and production decisions.
  • Modular kits, reusable asset systems, trim-sheet workflows, material libraries, or scalable world-building solutions.
  • An understanding of optimization, maintainability, asset reuse, and production constraints.
  • At least one example in which you established or significantly influenced the visual quality bar for a scene, level, biome, or project.
  • The ability to work from concept art, reference, blockouts, design requirements, or incomplete creative direction.
  • Adaptability across different projects, genres, or visual styles.
  • We also encourage applicants to include examples of:
    • Work created by a team under their artistic or technical guidance.
    • Before-and-after comparisons showing how they improved an environment, workflow, or production outcome.
    • Benchmark assets, style guides, review materials, pipeline documentation, paintovers, or templates created for other artists.
  • Please clearly identify your individual contribution to collaborative work.

How to apply

  • Resume + portfolio link required.
  • An art test may be required as part of the process.
  • Please include shipped-game credits or comparable professional project experience where applicable.

Candidates may be asked to participate in a portfolio review, technical discussion, leadership interview, or art assessment as part of the selection process.

This position is currently open to candidates residing in the following Canada Provinces: Ontario or British Columbia.

Salary Range: $120,000 CAD to $130,000 CAD

What's in it for you?

  • Opportunities to contribute to a variety of projects, clients, genres, platforms, and visual styles.
  • The ability to influence environment-art quality and production practices across multiple teams.
  • Collaboration with experienced developers and studios across the Keywords Studios organization.
  • Professional-development and mentorship opportunities.
  • Flexible remote, hybrid, and in-office work arrangements where available.
  • 3 weeks of paid leave
  • Benefits package including medical, dental and vision
  • Sick Leave
  • Disability Coverage
  • Corporate holidays
  • Professional Development

Keywords Studios is dedicated to following a well-established Equal Opportunities Policy. We endeavor to create a workplace which provides for equal opportunities for all employees and potential employees.

jobs.description:
Innovation is and will always be the core of SAP Fioneer, and it is the promise of why we were spun out of SAP: agility, innovation, and delivery.

SAP Fioneer builds on a heritage of outstanding technology and a deep understanding of corporate and consumer demands. At the heart of it all it is simple: We bring financial services to the next level with innovative software solutions and platforms.

We are helping companies in the financial services industry to achieve speed, scalability, and cost-efficiency through digital business innovation, cloud technology, and solutions that cover banking and insurance processes end-to-end.

A global company, with rapid growth, innovative people, and a lean organization makes SAP Fioneer a place where you accelerate your future!

About role

As a Senior SAP ABAP Engineer you will be playing a key role in building the backend of a cloud-based SaaS platform built on S/4HANA technologies. In this role, you will develop and maintain scalable, secure and high-performance components that meet our clients’ needs. Your expertise will play a crucial role in delivering innovative solutions and enhancing the functionality of our Fioneer offerings. If you enjoy solving complex technical problems, ensure a clean-core and want to contribute to a next-generation SaaS platform, this role is for you. As a Senior Engineer you will also share your experience with junior colleagues and be take part in their further education and development.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain scalable and secure backend components for innovative lending solutions built on ABAP and further SAP technologies.
  • Build high-quality standard software in an agile environment, collaborating directly with internal stakeholders, customers and partners.
  • Partner closely with front-end developers, designers, and product owners to deliver end-to-end solutions.
  • Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues.
  • Ensure engineering excellence through structured testing (unit, integration, UAT support), adherence to clean code principles and continuous improvements.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation.
  • Stay up to date with innovations in S/4HANA, RAP, and SAP BTP.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in ABAP object-oriented development (experience in financial sector is a plus).
  • Proficiency in OData, Core Data Services (CDS), and ABAP RESTful Application Programming (RAP) is mandatory.
  • Practical experience with SAP BTP (its services, deployment approach, and integration concepts).
  • Familiarity with modern SAP development tools such as Business Application Studio (BAS), Eclipse, Visual Studio preferred.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to break down technical complexity.
  • Strong communication skills with ability to collaborate effectively across teams.
  • Fluency in English.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with banking products and processes (e.g., retail lending, regulatory reporting).
  • Full-stack experience with SAP UI5 & Fiori for designing modern and responsive user interfaces.
  • Some experience in SAP HANA DB.
  • Prior exposure to event-driven architecture and integration patterns on SAP BTP.
  • Experience working in agile environments (Scrum / SAFe) and in international teams.

Benefits

You will have the opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry on an incredibly ambitious project to shape the ever-evolving financial sector. This is an environment where you can have it all - the agility, enthusiasm and dynamism of a start-up, combined with the established expertise, solid market presence and extensive customer network of a more established organization.

At SAP Fioneer, you will benefit from a flexible work environment that encourages creativity and encourages you to think outside the box, bring new ideas to the table, and challenge the status quo. You will become part of a diverse and global team that we are proud of and are constantly growing and reinventing. As an employee, you will have the chance to chart your own career path and take advantage of competitive compensation packages and progression opportunities based on merit.

We offer pension plans and life insurance for financial security. Our health and wellbeing benefits include private medical insurance, wellness cover, and an employee assistance program. Additionally, our mobility benefits vary based on seniority level and include company car benefits and transportation assistance. Furthermore, we provide additional perks such as celebration rewards, a jubilee program, and a meal program.

jobs.excerpt: Aurora Group is a global advertising and technology company built to support performance marketers.
jobs.description:
Aurora Group is a global advertising and technology company built to support performance marketers. Our ecosystem includes access to premium ad accounts, our proprietary SaaS platform, in-house educational platform, and a performance marketing arm for e-commerce and lead gen. Thousands of companies, from solo media buyers to global teams, rely on our infrastructure to scale, optimize spend, and grow profitably.

We're expanding our Business Development team to better support our growing client base across the Americas, including our Portuguese-speaking clients in Brazil and our wider US client base. This role sits at the centre of our commercial engine, owning the full client relationship from first inbound message through long-term account growth. You'll work closely with our Client Support Advisors (who handle inbound chats) to convert warm leads into clients, and with operations to make sure every client is set up for success.

If you thrive on turning conversations into revenue, building long-term client relationships, and growing your own network within a fast-moving industry, this role is for you.

Tasks

  • Convert warm inbound leads (allocated to you by our Client Support Advisors) into clients, handling the full commercial cycle from qualification to close
  • Adapt your approach to different client profiles, from solo affiliates just starting out, to established media buying operations, to brands new to paid acquisition
  • Own the commercial side of ongoing client relationships, tracking revenue, minimising drop-off, and surfacing referral and expansion opportunities
  • Cover inbound leads across North and South America during US hours, serving both English-speaking and Portuguese-speaking clients
  • Build and grow your own network within the performance marketing community across the Americas
  • Progress into outbound business development over time, leveraging the network and industry knowledge you build in the role to open new opportunities
  • Collaborate closely with our existing clients and partners to circulate opportunities and strengthen Aurora's presence in the region
  • Feed insights back to the team on client needs, competitor activity, and market trends

Requirements

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these, we encourage you to apply. Meeting any of the preferred qualifications is a bonus.

Minimum Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in business development, sales, or account management, with a track record of closing warm inbound or relationship-led deals
  • Native or fluent Portuguese and near-perfect English, both written and spoken
  • Strong written communication, as the majority of your client conversations will happen over chat and email
  • Ability to quickly read a lead and adapt your approach, with no spammy templates and no unnecessary back-and-forth when a client is ready to move
  • Comfortable handling objections and proposing solutions, even on topics that are new to you
  • Likeable, commercially minded, and proactive, the kind of person clients want to keep working with and refer others to
  • Self-directed and comfortable working remotely in US hours
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, ideally with a history of side projects, independent ventures, or building something of your own alongside full-time work

Preferred Requirements

  • Business development or sales experience at a payments or card issuing provider, with an existing book of contacts that overlaps with online advertisers and media buyers
  • Prior dropshipping or e-commerce experience, with existing connections to online sellers
  • Based in Brazil, with an existing network in the local affiliate marketing, media buying, or e-commerce community
  • Experience selling to or working with media buyers, affiliates, or e-commerce operators
  • Background at an affiliate network, CPA network, tracking or attribution platform, proxy provider, or similar tooling used by performance marketers
  • Background in affiliate marketing, ad tech, fintech, performance marketing, SaaS, or another fast-moving startup environment
  • Additional languages (Spanish especially useful for broader Americas coverage)
  • Experience working across timezones with a distributed team

Benefits

Remote-First at Aurora

At Aurora, we are proud to be a fully remote team with talented members working across the globe. We believe in the power of flexibility while fostering a highly collaborative environment. Our team is spread across different time zones, but we stay connected through regular virtual meetings, collaborative tools, and open communication channels.

If this sounds like a fit, we'd love to hear from you. Please submit your CV along with a short note about your relevant experience and why you're interested in the role.

Our hiring process typically involves an initial screening call, followed by one or two interviews with members of the Business Development and leadership teams, and may include a short practical exercise to see how you'd approach a real client scenario. We aim to move quickly and keep candidates informed at every stage.

Get started on an exciting career at Element!

Element employees make a difference in the lives of others every day. We are re-defining the fleet management industry to be people first, then business – delivering on our promise of a superior client experience. This takes hard work and innovation, and we need more like-minded people on our team.

This is an evergreen position intended to build a pipeline of qualified candidates for anticipated future openings. While we may not have an immediate vacancy today, we regularly hire for this role and encourage interested candidates to apply so we can connect as opportunities become available.

About the Role

As a Sales Director on our Commercial Sales team you will directly impact the financial success of the organization through the acquisition of new business and the development of strategic customer relationships. You will drive profitable revenue growth by identifying, developing, and closing complex commercial opportunities while positioning Element as a trusted business advisor. Success in this role requires a strong hunter mentality, consultative selling skills, executive presence, financial acumen, risk mitigation, and the ability to lead complex sales opportunities through a structured sales process.

What You’ll Do

  • Generate new business opportunities and acquire new clients within assigned territory and target segments.
  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline through strategic prospecting, networking, referrals, industry engagement, and outbound business development activities.
  • Lead complex sales opportunities from initial discovery through contract execution and implementation.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams including Risk, Legal, Operations, Implementation, Product, and Client Success to ensure successful deal execution.
  • Conduct executive-level business discussions with C-suite stakeholders, predominantly Finance, Treasury, Procurement, and Operations leaders.
  • Identify strategic business challenges and align Element solutions to measurable operational and financial outcomes.
  • Develop and execute strategic territory and account plans to maximize market penetration, opportunity creation, and long-term revenue growth.
  • Maintain accurate forecasting and opportunity management through CRM and sales enablement tools in alignment with Element’s preferred sales framework.
  • Serve as a market expert by identifying industry trends, competitive insights, customer needs, and emerging opportunities that support Element's growth strategy.
  • Remain current on Element’s products and services to effectively position solutions that align with client needs.

​Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, or related field required.
  • Minimum 7+ years of successful experience in complex B2B solution sales environments.
  • Minimum of 5 years of sales, customer management, or direct fleet management experience.
  • Ability to travel at least 50% of the time.
  • Proven track record of exceeding sales quotas and revenue objectives.
  • Demonstrated success acquiring new customers through a structured sales methodology.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or advanced business degree preferred.
  • Preferred experience in a financial services customer-facing commercial position.
  • Preferred experience within the vehicle management or a related fleet, financial, or asset-based industry.
  • Experience within fleet management, mobility, transportation, financial services, leasing, business services, or other asset-intensive industries preferred.
  • Experience leveraging Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, 6sense, or similar sales intelligence platforms.
  • Strong communication, influencing, relationship-building, project management, and critical thinking skills.

Location: Remote Canada

Compensation

The hiring base salary range for this position is $75,000 - $137,500 annually. This range represents the Company's good-faith estimate of the expected base salary at the time of posting. Salary ranges may vary based on the geographic location where the work is performed. The salary range listed in this posting applies only to the location identified. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including the successful candidate's qualifications, knowledge, skills, experience, internal pay equity, and relevant market data. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may participate in annual incentive programs, including bonuses, commissions, or other incentive compensation, as applicable to the role. Element also offers a comprehensive benefits package, which may include health insurance, tuition reimbursement, and retirement savings plans.

By applying, you'll be considered for future opportunities that align with your experience. While there may not be an immediate opening, our recruiting team reviews applications on an ongoing basis and may contact qualified candidates for exploratory conversations, networking opportunities, or future positions as hiring needs arise. Because this is a talent pipeline posting, the timing of recruiter outreach will vary based on business needs and anticipated openings.

What’s in it for You
• A culture of innovation, empowerment, decision-making, and accountability
• Comprehensive health and welfare benefits that serve the needs of you and your family and foster a culture of wellness (for qualified roles)
• Additional benefits and amenities, including paid time-off programs (vacation, sick leave, and holidays) (for qualified roles)

Applicants will be required to undergo a background check only if and after a conditional offer of employment has been extended.

Element Fleet Management and its wholly owned subsidiaries are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We are pleased to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, genetic information, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, family status, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, physical or mental disability, veteran status, military obligations or any other characteristic protected by federal, state and local laws. Title

This role is eligible for full-time remote employment within the US or can be hybrid in our Durham, NC office 2-3 days/week. Please note that we unfortunately cannot sponsor H1B visas at this time. Aprio participates in the US Government's eVerify Program.

Who We Are

Modern enterprises run their most critical applications in complex, cloud-native environments, and the threats keep multiplying: outages, ransomware, bad actors, human error. Most disaster recovery tools stop at backing up data. We’ve built the next generation of cloud resiliency and disaster recovery for AWS and Azure with an automated, application-aware platform that recovers a company's entire application stack, not isolated resources, in under an hour. We protect production workloads for enterprises that cut across multiple industries like healthcare, financial services, and SaaS — the kind of companies that can't afford downtime.

At Arpio, we believe great companies are built by people who take ownership, move with urgency, and consistently deliver results. We just closed our $15M Series A to expand into new clouds and build out our roadmap, which means we're growing the team right now, and your work will directly shape where we go next.

About the Role

As our Senior Enterprise Account Executive focused on Microsoft Azure, you'll own one of the most strategic growth initiatives in our business.

You'll be responsible for developing enterprise opportunities, expanding executive relationships, and driving joint success with Microsoft. Working alongside our Microsoft Alliance Manager, you'll help build and execute our Microsoft go-to-market strategy while positioning Arpio as the preferred disaster recovery and ransomware recovery solution for Azure workloads.

This is a highly visible role with direct influence on our growth strategy, our Microsoft partnership, and the future of the company.

As enterprises continue moving mission-critical workloads to Azure, resilience has become a board-level priority. We're looking for a proven enterprise seller to help define how organizations think about cloud resilience while building one of Microsoft's premier cloud partner relationships.

This isn't simply another enterprise sales role.

It's an opportunity to help build a company.

What You'll Do

At Arpio, we care about the outcome as much as the effort it took to get there. We take initiative, follow through, and report back on what we learned along the way. That same instinct shows up in how we treat customers and each other: we respond quickly, speak honestly and openly, and trust our teammates to take direct feedback as a chance to grow. We move like a startup because we are one, spending wisely and treating every dollar and every customer like they matter, because they do. If that's how you like to work, you'll fit in well here. For this role, that looks like:

Own the Full Sales Cycle

  • Own the complete enterprise sales cycle from prospecting through close.
  • Own Arpio's Microsoft Azure business, partnering closely with our Microsoft Alliance Manager to build joint account plans, expand executive relationships, and execute our Microsoft go-to-market strategy.
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans across enterprise Azure customers.
  • Generate qualified pipeline through executive prospecting, existing relationships, outbound strategies, and Microsoft co-sell activities.
  • Build trusted relationships with CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, Infrastructure Leaders, Cloud Architects, and executive decision-makers.
  • Partner directly with Microsoft Azure Account Executives, Cloud Solution Architects (CSAs), Customer Success Managers (CSMs), Partner Development Managers (PDMs), Technical Specialists, and Marketplace teams.
  • Execute Azure co-sell opportunities that create measurable business value for customers while accelerating Azure consumption.
  • Drive Azure Marketplace opportunities and collaborate on joint account planning with Microsoft.
  • Develop compelling business cases that align technical value with executive business outcomes.
  • Lead complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders from discovery through contract execution.
  • Partner closely with Arpio Solutions Engineering throughout technical evaluations, demonstrations, and proof-of-value engagements.
  • Maintain forecast accuracy, disciplined CRM hygiene, and consistent pipeline management.

Build the Microsoft Partnership

Our Microsoft partnership is one of the most important strategic initiatives at Arpio.

Unlike many organizations where alliances and sales operate independently, you'll work as a unified team with our Microsoft Channel & Alliance Partner Manager to own Microsoft's field engagement within your territory.

Together, you'll:

  • Build relationships across Microsoft's sales and technical organizations.
  • Develop joint account strategies and executive engagement plans.
  • Identify and execute Azure co-sell opportunities.
  • Expand Marketplace adoption.
  • Increase Azure consumption through customer success.
  • Position Arpio as Microsoft's preferred cloud resilience partner.

Success in this role requires someone who understands that winning with Microsoft isn't simply about relationships, it's about delivering value for Microsoft, the customer, and Arpio.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who has already proven they can win inside the Microsoft ecosystem.

Required qualifications include:

  • 5+ years of successful enterprise SaaS, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, disaster recovery, data protection, or related enterprise technology sales.
  • A consistent track record of exceeding quota through enterprise new logo acquisition.
  • Direct experience selling solutions within Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Proven experience executing Microsoft Azure co-sell opportunities alongside Microsoft's sales and technical organizations.
  • Experience working directly with Azure Account Executives, Cloud Solution Architects (CSAs), Customer Success Managers (CSMs), Partner Development Managers (PDMs), Technical Specialists, or Marketplace teams.
  • Experience selling complex enterprise solutions involving multiple stakeholders and executive decision-makers.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to engage CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, and senior business leaders.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, negotiation, and business case development skills.
  • A highly self-motivated, accountable individual who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment.

This is not an entry-level Microsoft role. We're looking for someone who understands how Microsoft sells, how Azure co-sell works, and how to build credibility with Microsoft's field organization from day one.

Salary and Benefits

  • Competitive salary + Equity
  • Arpio will cover 100% of your personal medical premiums, 100% of your life insurance premium, and 75% of your personal premiums for vision and dental (because the insurance companies won’t let us pay 100%). For your dependents, Arpio will cover 75% of medical, dental, and vision premiums. No life insurance is included.
  • For fully remote employees, a $125 home office stipend or $250 company-subsidized co-working membership
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Small, collaborative team environment
  • Opportunity to work on the cutting edge of cloud technology

Arpio is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive workplace, and we welcome applicants of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. About zerohash

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.

The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. Through a single integration, customers can launch regulated crypto buy, sell, and custody services; enable 24/7 stablecoin-based funding, payouts, and settlement; and issue and manage tokenized assets with built-in compliance, risk controls, and reporting. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global.

zerohash is trusted by some of the world’s most recognized financial and consumer brands, including Interactive Brokers, Morgan Stanley, Stripe, Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, DraftKings, Gusto, Worldpay, Kalshi, One Pay, among others. Today, zerohash infrastructure supports millions of end users across brokerage, wealth, payments, and marketplace platforms globally.

The company is deeply regulated and compliance-first, operating across the U.S. and internationally with licenses and approvals that allow partners to enter crypto and stablecoins with confidence. zerohash has become a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to modernize financial products while meeting the highest standards for security, risk management, and regulatory oversight.

To date, zerohash has raised over $280 million in funding from a mix of leading venture firms and strategic investors, including Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Point72 Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and more.

zerohash has been featured in top-tier media outlets such as Bloomberg, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Forbes, and CoinDesk, and its leadership team regularly contributes to global conversations on the future of payments, investing, and financial infrastructure.

At zerohash, we're building the infrastructure that makes digital money work securely, compliantly, and at global scale.

All zerohash employees are guided by the following characteristics and core principles:

  • Empathy - An ability to listen, respect, and understand your co-workers, customers, and everyone you interact with no matter how different they are to you.
  • Adaptability - An ability to respond quickly. We are in a fast-paced industry and so we expect you to be creative when solving a new problem and comfortable under pressure.
  • Transparency - We believe that transparency is critical to empowering everyone to make the best decisions, both the company to its people and vice versa.
  • Integrity - Integrity creates trust. As both an organization collectively and as individuals, it is our most valuable asset.

About Workstreet

At Workstreet, we’re on an exciting journey to help businesses scale securely by designing and implementing cutting-edge security and compliance programs. As a fast-growing startup, we specialize in a wide range of GRC (governance, risk, and compliance) services that support frameworks across SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, CMMC, NIST 800-171, NIST 800-53, and FedRAMP. We empower companies to meet regulatory requirements and enhance their cybersecurity posture from day one.

About the Trust Services Team

In addition to GRC services, we also have a Trust Services team. We move at a fast, focused, and reliable pace – completing deliverables within 1 to 3 business days for customers with 5 clients and customers with 500 clients. We work directly with our customers’ security and sales points of contact, meaning clarity, teamwork, and problem-solving are at the forefront of everything we do to help our customers drive sales and renewals by using security and compliance as differentiators. If you want to be part of a team that builds the bridge between sales and security, you’re in the right place.

The Opportunity

Workstreet is looking for a results-oriented Trust Services Engineer to support our Trust Services team. Your primary responsibility will be to complete customer security questionnaires and other due diligence requests. Your work will be reviewed by Senior Engineers and Managers, giving you exposure to on-the-job feedback. This role is primarily focused on efficiently and accurately entering information from our customers’ existing compliance resources into standardized responses.

What You'll Do

  • Complete and submit security questionnaires -serve as the primary responder for customer due diligence requests, leveraging established response frameworks, internal policy documentation, and compliance control libraries to deliver accurate, on-time submissions.
  • Research and validate responses -dig into client-specific questions that fall outside standard frameworks, sourcing supporting evidence from compliance platforms and coordinating with internal security and compliance teams to verify accuracy before submission.
  • Maintain consistency and quality across all deliverables - ensure every response reflects current, approved language and aligns with the customer’s broader security posture; flag gaps or outdated documentation when identified.
  • Collaborate with internal teams - coordinate with compliance and security teams to verify information and ensure consistency across all submissions.

Who You Are

  • Energized by time-sensitive deliverables - you do your best work when there's a hard deadline on the horizon, moving quickly without sacrificing quality.
  • Confidence in your decision making - ambiguity doesn't slow you down because you make a call, prepare yourself for any justification, and move on. Clear communication skills to escalate issues and identify gaps, rather than guessing.
  • Strong sense of prioritization - you’re able to understand the work assigned to you and communicate blockers proactively.
  • Sharp attention to detail - you bring exceptional attention to detail and a consistent, disciplined approach to following established processes.
  • Ability to read and interpret security policies and documentation - comfortable navigating in-house technology to review dense technical documents to extract accurate, relevant answers on behalf of clients.
  • Familiarity with vendor/third-party risk concepts - familiar with the purpose and structure of common security questionnaire formats (via Excel sheets and portals) and understands how responses feed into a client's vendor risk management process, including control domains, risk tiering, and subprocessor considerations.
  • Basic understanding of cybersecurity concepts and frameworks - you have had exposure to at least one of the following: SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR; can explain the difference between basic data definitions (e.g., the difference between business confidential information vs. PII vs. PHI); and understand concepts around confidentiality, integrity, and availability (CIA) of data, including controls related to authentication, access management, encryption, physical controls vs. logical controls, etc.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with cloud environments such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Experience using compliance automation tools (Drata, Vanta, SecureFrame, etc.).
  • Experience with vendor risk management tools (OneTrust, ServiceNow, Whistic, Upguard, Zip, etc.)

What We Offer

  • Career Development: Clear path with mentorship and training opportunities.
  • Technical Training: Reimbursement for relevant successful certification completion.
  • Competitive Compensation: A competitive base salary with regular performance reviews linked to merit-based appraisals and bonus opportunities.
  • Growth Opportunity: Early-stage company with significant room for career advancement.
  • Remote-First Culture: Flexibility to work from anywhere while collaborating with a global team.

Work Environment Requirements

  • Fluency in written and verbal English.
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connection.
  • Quiet, professional home office setup.
  • Able to work US Eastern Time zone hours, specifically 8 AM EST to 5 PM EST.
  • Able to work on non-US public holidays in order to meet deadlines for US-based clients.

jobs.excerpt: Who We AreNEXT Ventures is where ambition takes shape and momentum becomes movement.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

NEXT Ventures is where ambition takes shape and momentum becomes movement. As a global platform revolutionising access to performance-based capital, we empower the world’s most driven individuals to rise. Through our flagship brand, FundedNext, we empower dreamers to become doers, and potential to turn into performance. With 500+ driven minds across five countries, we power a global rhythm—220,000+ daily users from 170+ nations, each chasing greatness in their own way.

Your Role in Our Mission

As Head of Risk at FundedNext, you will own the most strategically important function in any prop trading firm: the discipline that protects platform integrity and stabilises the economics that fund every trader’s journey. You will report directly to the FundedNext CEO and become the senior owner of risk decisions across CFD and Futures — and the lead architect of risk infrastructure for the upcoming Crypto programme.

This is not a role where you inherit a fully-built function. You inherit ambition, complex data, and a team that needs senior leadership. Your first 90 days are a diagnostic. From that diagnosis, you build.

How You’ll Make an Impact

Stabilise the Book

  • Reduce payout ratio variance and bring discipline to the firm’s primary health metric across CFD and Futures. Translate trader behaviour data into product-rule decisions that protect long-term sustainability without throttling the trader experience.

Audit, Then Build

  • In your first 90 days, conduct an end-to-end gap analysis of our existing risk framework — surveillance tooling, policies, escalation paths, dealing operations integration. From that diagnostic, design and implement a risk operating model fit for FundedNext’s scale through 2028.

Lead Crypto Risk Readiness

  • Design risk policies, surveillance models, drawdown rules, and operational guardrails for the Crypto programme launching. Crypto carries different volatility, exposure, and abuse patterns than CFD or Futures — your work here defines whether we launch safely.

Hunt Fraud and Abuse

  • Strengthen detection and response to multi-account abuse, identity fraud, and toxic trading patterns. Partner with Engineering, Data, Compliance, and Customer Operations to build a defensible, scalable abuse-prevention capability.

Partner Across the Firm

  • Be the trusted risk voice in product design, dealing operations, engineering, compliance, and analytics. Influence — and where required, veto — decisions that materially shift FundedNext’s risk profile. You will report directly to the CEO and have the authority to escalate independently when material risk events demand it.

What You Bring

  • 8–12 years of risk experience across prop trading, CFD brokerage, or multi-asset financial services.

  • Genuine multi-asset fluency — you understand CFD, Futures, and ideally Crypto economics, instruments, and abuse patterns.

  • A track record of building or rebuilding a risk function — frameworks, policies, surveillance tooling, team.

  • Hands-on credibility on B-book and dealing operations; you have personal exposure to payout ratio management at scale.

  • Strong cross-functional influence — you can hold your own with Product, Engineering, and Trading leaders.

  • Comfort with ambiguity — you can step into an under-defined function and bring clarity quickly.

  • Excellent communication — to traders, to your CEO, to your future board.

Your X-Factor

What sets the strongest candidates apart:

  • You have personal scar tissue from a payout-ratio crisis or major abuse incident — and you can talk about how you turned it around.

  • You speak the language of data and engineering well enough to design surveillance models with quants and ML engineers, even if you don’t write production code yourself.

  • You have led risk policy design for a new asset class launch — ideally Crypto.

  • You think about trader experience and risk economics in the same sentence — not as opposing forces.

  • You see AI and machine learning as the future of risk surveillance and bring opinions about how to deploy them responsibly.

Your Journey After Applying

  1. Initial conversation with our Talent Acquisition team.

  2. 60 minutes interview with management team and HoD

Due to the continuing success and growth of our AESG team, a fantastic opportunity has opened up at our award-winning Specialist Consultancy, Engineering and Advisory Firm.

We are headquartered in London, Riyadh, Singapore and Dubai, Cape Town, Cairo & Sydney working throughout the Middle East, Europe and Asia. Our areas of expertise are represented in four core verticals: Building Engineering, Planning and Infrastructure, Strategy and Advisory and Commissioning, Handover and Asset Management.

We pride ourselves in being leaders in the industry in each of the services that we offer. We have one of the largest dedicated team with decades of cumulative experience in sustainable design, fire and life safety, cost management, façade engineering, commissioning, building performance, waste management, environmental consultancy, carbon management and acoustics.

JOB PURPOSE

The Senior Building Physicist will lead and deliver advanced building performance and urban physics assessments across building and master planning projects. The role covers daylight and glare, thermal comfort, microclimate and wind comfort, solar radiation, energy performance, building envelope optimisation, passive design, climate resilience and decarbonisation. The role will translate simulation results into practical, design-led recommendations and optimisation strategies; establish robust modelling methodologies and workflows; ensure technical quality and consistency of deliverables; and support multidisciplinary project delivery and client engagement.

QUALIFICATION / EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in building physics, Architectural Engineering, Mechanical , Civil Engineering, Building Services Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Minimum 4–7 years of relevant professional experience in building physics, building performance simulation, environmental design, energy modelling, microclimate analysis, or sustainability consulting, preferably within multidisciplinary design or engineering consultancy.

  • Proven practical experience with building performance and environmental simulation tools, supported by strong knowledge of relevant international and regional standards, codes and sustainability frameworks.

  • Experience in energy auditing and operational building performance analysis is desirable, including the ability to interpret measured data and identify energy conservation and optimisation opportunities.

  • Advanced proficiency in environmental analysis tools such as IES, Rhino/Grasshopper, Ladybug/Honeybee, ClimateStudio, ENVI met and/or CFD platforms.

  • Demonstrated experience delivering daylight, glare, thermal comfort, solar radiation, wind/microclimate and building envelope optimisation studies for buildings and/or masterplans.

  • Experience working with architects, landscape architects, MEP engineers and sustainability teams to influence design decisions through performance-based analysis.

  • Professional accreditation such as LEED AP, WELL AP, Estidama PQP, CIBSE, ASHRAE or equivalent is advantageous.

SKILLS / EXPERTISE REQUIRED

  • Building performance simulation: advanced understanding of heat transfer, solar gains, internal loads, HVAC interactions, thermal comfort and whole-building energy performance.

  • Daylight and glare analysis: ability to undertake and interpret daylight availability, daylight autonomy, glare and visual comfort assessments and translate results into façade and space-planning recommendations.

  • Microclimate and urban physics: strong capability in solar radiation, outdoor thermal comfort, pedestrian wind comfort, shading and climate-responsive masterplanning assessments.

  • Building envelope and passive design: expertise in façade performance, glazing selection, shading optimisation, orientation, massing, natural ventilation and other passive design strategies.

  • Modelling tools and workflows: strong hands-on capability with IES-VE; strong hands-on knowledge of Rhino/Grasshopper, Ladybug/Honeybee and ClimateStudio; experience with CFD tools such as OpenFOAM or equivalent. Ability to develop parametric and comparative modelling workflows is highly desirable.

  • Energy and decarbonisation: ability to develop energy conservation measures, compare design options, assess renewable energy opportunities and support operational energy and decarbonisation strategies.

  • Standards and compliance: strong working knowledge of ASHRAE and CIBSE guidance and relevant regional codes; familiarity with LEED, WELL, BREEAM, Estidama/PBRS, Mostadam/PCRS and Saudi Building Code requirements relevant to building physics.

  • Technical QA/QC: ability to define modelling assumptions and methodologies, review models and calculations, challenge inputs and results, troubleshoot modelling issues, and ensure outputs are technically defensible and fit for purpose.

  • Data analysis and technical reporting: ability to analyse large simulation datasets, identify performance drivers and clearly communicate findings through concise reports, dashboards, graphics and presentations.

  • Design advisory and communication: ability to convert complex simulation results into practical design recommendations and communicate effectively with clients, architects, engineers and non-specialist stakeholders.

  • Project and team leadership: ability to plan technical workstreams, manage priorities and deadlines, review deliverables, mentor team members and coordinate multidisciplinary inputs.

  • Commercial awareness: understanding of scope, programme, fee utilisation and change management, with the ability to support proposals, technical scopes and client presentations.

GENERAL EXPECTANCY

  • Demonstrates advanced technical expertise and sound professional judgement across core building physics disciplines.

  • Provides proactive technical leadership, design insight and evidence-based recommendations that improve project outcomes.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Core Role

  • Lead urban physics and environmental performance assessments across building and master planning projects, providing technical direction across daylight, glare, thermal comfort, microclimate, energy, passive design, climate resilience, and decarbonisation.

  • Translate simulation outputs and technical analysis into practical, design-led recommendations, performance targets, and optimisation strategies for architects, engineers, developers, and clients.

  • Establish project methodologies, modelling approaches, assessment criteria, and workflows, while ensuring the quality and technical robustness of project deliverables.

  • Collaborate and coordinate with architects, engineers, and sustainability consultants to integrate building physics principles into design solutions.

Technical Responsibilities

  • Lead and undertake advanced assessments covering daylight, glare, thermal comfort, microclimate, wind comfort, solar radiation, energy performance, building envelope optimisation, passive design and renewable energy.

  • Develop and optimise building and masterplan strategies, including orientation, massing, façade design, glazing, shading, landscape and other passive measures.

  • Develop and manage simulation workflows using tools such as IES-VE, Rhino/Grasshopper, Honeybee/Ladybug, ClimateStudio, OpenFOAM and CFD workflows, including parametric and comparative studies where required.

Standards & Compliance

  • Interpret and apply relevant international and regional standards, codes, and sustainability frameworks, including LEED, WELL, Mostadam/PCRS, Estidama PBRS, Saudi Building Code, ASHRAE, CIBSE, and NEN 8100.

  • Establish appropriate and defensible methodologies for demonstrating compliance, particularly where project requirements are ambiguous or require interpretation, and advise project teams on performance targets and compliance strategies.

  • Contribute to sustainability certifications (e.g., LEED, BREEAM, Estidama, WELL, Mostadam) where applicable.

  • Stay updated with evolving codes, standards, and best practices in building physics, energy performance, and environmental design.

Project & Client Responsibilities

  • Lead technical discussions with clients and multidisciplinary teams, communicating complex building physics concepts and simulation findings in a clear and design-oriented manner.

  • Coordinate with architecture, landscape, MEP and other disciplines to integrate environmental performance considerations into design development, while managing technical deliverables, programme requirements and project priorities.

Team Leadership

Business Development & Service Development

DEMONSTRATED KNOWLEDGE BASE AND PROFESSIONAL SKILLSET

  • Time Management / Planning - Plans and manages technical workstreams and projects, including programmes, budgets, resources, dependencies, quality requirements and delivery risks.

  • Industry Experience / Thought Leadership - Demonstrated expertise in discipline, industry leadership through participation in industry professional groups and conferences and the development of research publications.

Resolves complex project issues and contributes to improving cross-functional delivery processes and efficiency.

jobs.description:
The client is an Australian finance-broking business based in Queensland.

The business provides tailored finance solutions across home loans, refinancing, investment lending, commercial finance, business loans, equipment finance and personal lending.

With access to a broad panel of banks and lenders, they works closely with clients to understand their circumstances and identify suitable finance solutions. The team is committed to providing a personalised, efficient and well-organised experience from the initial enquiry through to application and settlement.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly organised Mortgage Broking Support Specialist to assist with loan administration, client follow-ups, compliance documentation, serviceability calculations and application preparation.

The successful candidate will help maintain accurate and complete client files in Mercury, follow up on outstanding documents and assessment requirements, prepare compliance and Best Interests Duty notes, and support the submission of applications through ApplyOnline.

This role requires strong attention to detail, practical knowledge of the Australian mortgage-broking process and the ability to manage multiple client files at different stages.

The key objective is to provide dependable back-office support so brokers can spend more time advising clients while ensuring applications remain accurate, compliant and moving forward.

Key Responsibilities

Client Communication & Follow-Ups

  • Send professional reminders to clients regarding outstanding information, documents and upcoming requirements.
  • Follow up on requested supporting documents, including payslips, bank statements, identification and other application evidence.
  • Follow up on additional documents or information requested during lender assessment.
  • Check received documents against the outstanding requirements list and update the client file accordingly.
  • Keep clients informed of the next administrative steps in the application process.
  • Escalate delays, incomplete information or client concerns to the broker promptly.
  • Maintain clear and professional written communication throughout the client journey.

Compliance & Best Interests Duty Notes

  • Assist with preparing accurate compliance and Best Interests Duty notes based on information and instructions supplied by the broker.
  • Ensure relevant research, discussions, product comparisons and supporting information are clearly documented.
  • Check that required compliance documents and disclosures are present in each client file.
  • Maintain complete and orderly records to support internal reviews and potential audits.
  • Identify missing or inconsistent information and refer it to the broker for clarification.
  • Ensure all compliance work is completed in accordance with the business’s procedures and remains subject to broker review and approval.

Serviceability & Lender Research Support

  • Accurately enter client income, expenses, liabilities, assets and proposed lending details into lender or aggregator serviceability calculators.
  • Review the entered information carefully to ensure calculations reflect the client’s supplied documents.
  • Research lender policies and servicing requirements to identify options that may suit the client’s circumstances.
  • Compare servicing outcomes across relevant lenders and clearly document the results for broker review.
  • Check key policy considerations, including income treatment, employment type, liabilities, loan-to-value ratio and supporting-document requirements.
  • Flag policy exceptions, servicing concerns or unclear information to the broker.
  • Ensure that all lender recommendations and final credit advice remain the responsibility of the authorised mortgage broker.

Mercury CRM & File Management

  • Create, maintain and update client records in Mercury.
  • Ensure personal details, employment information, financial information, application data and contact records are current and accurate.
  • Tidy and organise Mercury files so documents, notes, tasks and application information are complete and easy to locate.
  • Apply consistent file names, categories and document-management procedures.
  • Update file notes after client communication, document receipt and application activity.
  • Check client files for incomplete fields, duplicate information or outdated records.
  • Maintain accurate task lists and follow-up dates across active applications.

Loan Application Preparation & Submission

  • Prepare loan applications for submission based on the broker’s instructions and approved lending strategy.
  • Enter application information accurately into ApplyOnline and relevant lender systems.
  • Upload supporting documents and ensure they are correctly labelled and attached.
  • Review applications for completeness and consistency before referring them to the broker.
  • Submit applications through ApplyOnline following final broker review and approval.
  • Record submission details, lender references, status updates and outstanding requirements in Mercury.
  • Monitor applications for lender updates and communicate new requirements to the broker.

Assessment Requirements & Application Progress

  • Monitor outstanding assessment requirements and lender requests.
  • Follow up with clients for updated payslips, bank statements or other time-sensitive documents.
  • Check received documents for completeness before providing them to the broker or lender.
  • Update Mercury tasks, notes and application stages as requirements are completed.
  • Maintain a clear overview of each application’s current status and next required action.
  • Escalate urgent, overdue or potentially problematic matters promptly.

Mercury Marketing Hub

  • Maintain accurate client contact and marketing information within Mercury.
  • Review client details to ensure marketing communications are relevant and correctly targeted.
  • Assist with sending approved client communications through the Mercury Marketing Hub.
  • Check that contact information, marketing preferences and campaign details are accurate before sending.
  • Ensure marketing communications follow the business’s approved templates and processes.
  • Identify incorrect, incomplete or duplicate client records and arrange the necessary updates.
  • Follow applicable privacy, consent and marketing-communication requirements.

Tools & Systems

  • Mercury CRM – practical experience strongly preferred
  • ApplyOnline – practical experience strongly preferred
  • Lender and aggregator serviceability calculators
  • Lender portals and policy resources
  • Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace
  • Email, document-management and PDF tools
  • Mortgage-broking compliance templates and checklists

Requirements

  • At least 4 years of mortgage-broking support, loan-processing or lending administration experience.
  • Practical experience supporting Australian mortgage brokers or working within the Australian lending industry.
  • Understanding of the Australian home-loan application process from initial data collection through to submission and assessment.
  • Experience entering client data into serviceability calculators accurately.
  • Ability to research and interpret lender policies and servicing requirements.
  • Experience preparing or maintaining mortgage-broking compliance documentation.
  • Understanding of Best Interests Duty requirements and the importance of accurate file notes.
  • Experience using Mercury CRM, ApplyOnline or comparable mortgage-broking platforms.
  • Strong attention to detail when reviewing client information and supporting documents.
  • Excellent written and spoken English with professional client-communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple client files, deadlines and follow-up requirements.
  • Strong judgement regarding when to resolve an administrative matter and when to escalate it to the broker.
  • High level of discretion when handling confidential personal and financial information.
  • Ability to follow established processes while identifying missing or inconsistent information.
  • Reliable internet connection and a professional home-office environment.
  • Ability to work Australian business hours.

Highly Desirable

  • Direct experience using Mercury Marketing Hub.
  • Experience supporting home loans, refinancing, investment lending and commercial finance applications.
  • Familiarity with a broad range of Australian lender policies and servicing calculators.
  • Experience preparing files for compliance reviews or audits.

Benefits

  • Dayshift - Australian Business Hours
  • Full time / WFH / Remote

dein profil

Cada comunidad autónoma convoca sus plazas a través de su propio servicio de salud, con su temario específico, sus bases y su baremo. Por eso buscamos preparadores que conozcan a fondo uno o varios servicios de salud: SAS, SERMAS, SACYL, SESCAM, SERGAS, SESPA, SALUD, SMS, SES, ICS, Osakidetza, IB-SALUT, SNS-O, SERIS, Servicio Canario de Salud, Servicio Cántabro de Salud o Conselleria de Sanidad (GVA).

🌟 Quiénes somos

En Polaris x Ucademy preparamos oposiciones de una forma más digital, práctica y personalizada. Ya hemos acompañado a miles de opositores y tenemos un objetivo claro: que 10.000 personas consigan su plaza preparándose con nosotros.

Para lograrlo, estamos ampliando nuestro claustro de preparadores de alto rendimiento.

Somos muy digitales, pero lo humano no se negocia. La tecnología nos ayuda a enseñar mejor, y son nuestros preparadores quienes aportan conocimiento, criterio, cercanía y acompañamiento.

🔎 A quién buscamos

  • Profesionales con plaza en un servicio de salud (personal estatutario o funcionario), en activo o en excedencia, en la categoría que quieren preparar.

  • Preparadores/as con experiencia en estas oposiciones.

  • Personas que conozcan el proceso de primera mano: temario común y específico, tipo de examen, baremo de méritos y bolsas de empleo.

  • Quienes sepan enseñar y acompañar: explicar con claridad, dar feedback útil y ayudar a sostener la preparación.

  • Soltura con herramientas digitales. Si ya utilizas IA en tu día a día, mucho mejor.

🎯 En qué podrás colaborar

Según tu perfil, categoría y disponibilidad, podrás participar en uno o varios proyectos:

  • Clases online dinámicas, prácticas y cercanas.

  • Temario común y específico adaptado a cada servicio de salud, con su actualización normativa.

  • Preguntas tipo test y simulacros con el formato real de cada convocatoria.

  • Supuestos prácticos, en las categorías que los incluyen.

  • Orientación sobre baremo, méritos y bolsas de empleo.

  • Seguimiento de alumnos: resolver dudas y ayudarles a avanzar.

  • Vídeos cortos, esquemas y resúmenes.

🤝 Cómo funciona la colaboración

No es un puesto de trabajo a jornada completa ni parcial. Colaborarás con Polaris x Ucademy mediante prestación de servicios en proyectos educativos concretos, compatible con tu actividad profesional.

Si trabajas en un servicio de salud, no te pedimos que dejes tu puesto. Queremos que pongas tu experiencia al servicio de otros opositores de una forma flexible.

🌍 100 % remoto
🕐 Horarios y disponibilidad a convenir, compatibles con turnos
📚 Proyectos y entregables definidos desde el inicio
💰 Compensación competitiva según el proyecto y los entregables

🎬 Cómo es el proceso de selección

Queremos conocerte enseñando, no solo leyendo tu CV. El proceso tiene tres pasos:

1. Revisión de perfil. En la candidatura responderás a unas preguntas breves y nos enviarás un vídeo de presentación de 1 minuto. Grábalo con el móvil, sin complicaciones: cuéntanos quién eres, tu experiencia y qué categoría y servicio de salud conoces.

2. Contacto de validación. Si tu perfil encaja, nos pondremos en contacto contigo por llamada o por escrito para resolver dudas, conocer tu disponibilidad y explicarte cómo colaboramos.

3. Clase de prueba y entrevista. Agendarás tu entrevista y, antes de la fecha, nos enviarás una clase grabada de máximo 5 minutos sobre un contenido de tu oposición, con un material de apoyo creado por ti. No buscamos una producción perfecta: queremos ver cómo explicas y cómo haces sencillo lo difícil.

jobs.description:
We’re hiring a Business Development Manager (full-cycle IC) to launch and validate a new B2B sales motion in the Polish hotel market. This is an MVP role: rather than executing an already-proven playbook, you’ll be the first person testing whether and how hotels buy our Hotel Profit Audit and wider Hotel Profit Management services/solutions — who the real decision-makers are, which messages and channels work, and whether a repeatable sales funnel emerges.

You’ll own the full cycle — prospecting, outreach, discovery, meetings, follow-up and eventually closing the first pilot clients — and report directly to the business owner driving this initiative, with coordination on the BnBerry side.

In the first 90 days, success will be defined by:

1) Researching accounts and identifying real decision-makers (owners/GMs)

2) Booking qualified discovery meetings

3) Keeping disciplined, complete CRM records

4) Capturing structured market feedback (objections, pricing sensitivity, effective messaging) to validate the offer and funnel

You’ll sell into hospitality buyers (owners, GMs) and should bring genuine outbound B2B sales discipline, even if you haven’t sold into hospitality before.

Requirements

Must-have experience & profile

  • 2–5 years in B2B sales / business development, with genuine hands-on cold-outbound experience (not inbound-only)
  • Core skills: prospecting and independently identifying decision-makers, cold calling, email/LinkedIn outreach, discovery, consultative selling
  • Strong CRM discipline: accurate contacts, clear next steps, call summaries, verified decision-makers

• Polish: C1 / native — mandatory

• English: B2+ — mandatory

  • Working style: independent, disciplined, curious, analytical, resilient to rejection
  • Comfortable capturing structured market feedback, not just selling — able to explain your own funnel and reasoning, not just execute a script
  • Comfortable operating without an established playbook, in a fully remote, no-office setup, with occasional fully company-paid travel to hotel meetings

Nice to have

  • Hospitality / hotel-tech / PMS / channel manager / OTA / revenue-tech background — preferred, though strong outbound B2B experience matters more than industry background
  • Prior experience selling a new or pre-validated product at MVP / early-stage
  • Russian: B2+ — materially improves speed and quality of direct feedback and internal discussion.

What “good” looks like

  • Comfortable with sustained daily outbound activity (calls, emails, LinkedIn outreach and follow-ups)
  • Able to explain your own funnel and numbers without checking notes: accounts researched, contacts reached, conversations, qualified meetings, reasons lost
  • Full-cycle ownership: contacts → conversations → qualified meetings → audit interest → proposal → pilot / contract
  • What we weigh most when hiring: real outbound B2B experience and prospecting/decision-maker identification come first, followed by discovery skills, language requirements, independence and CRM discipline — hospitality knowledge is a smaller, nice-to-have factor
  • Automatic no: no cold-outbound experience, inbound-only background, expecting a ready-made database or script, dislike of CRM, inability to explain a previous funnel, not speaking fluent Polish, or pitching on a mock call instead of running discovery

Benefits

• Fully remote / online — no office

  • Business trips for hotel meetings may be required and are fully paid by the company
  • Full-time/Part-time option can also be discussed

Backend & Integrations

  • Develop integrations with enterprise platforms (Dynamics 365, Coupa, Trackunit, Power Automate/Logic Apps).

  • Maintain and modernize legacy backend code (Java/J2EE and similar stacks) while delivering new services in whichever language best fits the module.

  • Document APIs using OpenAPI/Swagger and maintain versioned contracts for client teams.

Frontend

  • Contribute to Angular UI components for WorkPro modules as needed.

  • Support role-based UI flows for dispatchers, managers, and field technicians.

  • Help maintain responsive, mobile-friendly interfaces across devices.

Team & Delivery

  • Work with a Product Owner to deliver features in tight, iterative cycles.

  • Collaborate with a Principal Developer on architecture and engineering standards.

  • Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and production deployments.

  • Own backend features from design through release.

  • Experience with Dynamics 365, Power Automate, or Logic Apps.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks related to material structures, properties, processing, performance, and failure. A representative task may require constructing a material or atomic model, configuring and running a simulation, calculating relevant properties, analyzing the resulting outputs, and determining whether the solution is computationally valid and physically meaningful.

This role requires both strong materials expertise and experience using engineering or scientific tools programmatically. Experience limited exclusively to graphical user interfaces will not be sufficient, as task solutions must be reproducible through code, scripts, configuration files, or command-line tools.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Solve and validate computational materials-science and materials-engineering problems.
  2. Create material structures, atomic configurations, compositions, and solver-ready inputs.
  3. Model relationships between composition, structure, processing, properties, and performance.
  4. Run atomistic, electronic-structure, molecular-dynamics, continuum, electrochemical, or related simulations.
  5. Use Python to generate inputs, automate calculations, conduct parameter sweeps, process results, and validate outputs.
  6. Analyze mechanical, thermal, electrical, chemical, structural, or electrochemical properties.
  7. Diagnose failed calculations, invalid structures, convergence problems, numerical instability, and incorrect physical assumptions.
  8. Compare computational results with experimental data, literature values, known properties, or expected physical trends.
  9. Review AI-generated solutions for scientific correctness and identify invalid assumptions, configurations, or conclusions.
  10. Develop reproducible reference solutions and objective verification methods.

Required Qualifications

  1. An MS or PhD in Materials Science and Engineering, Metallurgy, or a closely related discipline; or
  2. An MS or PhD in Mechanical Engineering or Chemical Engineering with a substantial materials specialization.
  3. Strong understanding of materials behavior and relevant structure-property relationships.
  4. Experience with computational materials modeling, simulation, characterization, or materials-focused engineering analysis.
  5. Practical proficiency with Python.
  6. Experience with at least one engineering or scientific tool that can be operated through a CLI, scripting interface, configuration files, or programmatic API.
  7. Ability to understand and justify modeling assumptions, parameters, approximations, and convergence criteria.
  8. Ability to distinguish computational failures from genuine physical behavior.
  9. Ability to explain complex scientific reasoning and technical limitations clearly.

Relevant tools may include LAMMPS, ASE, pymatgen, Quantum ESPRESSO, FEniCSx, CalculiX, Elmer, PyBaMM, or similar programmatic materials and simulation software. Experience with an equivalent CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.

Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter, atomistic modeling packages, materials informatics libraries, or domain-specific scientific tools. No single library is mandatory.

Experience may come from academic research, national laboratories, industry R&D, computational engineering, or other demonstrated materials work.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete a technical assessment, if required.
  4. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

  1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

jobs.excerpt: As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena is committed to a people-first approach.
jobs.description:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena is committed to a people-first approach. Our teams enjoy a culture focused on prioritizing a flexible work environment that empowers individual growth, well-being, and belonging. We’re a technology company that leads with our humanity—driving our business priorities alongside meaningful social, community, and societal impact.

How You Will Contribute

Reporting to the Services organization, you will play a hands-on role in delivering network solutions and providing post-sales technical support. You’ll work closely with internal teams, service partners, and customers to ensure seamless deployment, reconfiguration, and ongoing improvements of Ciena’s solutions.

  • Lead solution delivery activities including remote deployment support, network migrations, and acceptance testing
  • Support partner engineers during deployments and act as an escalation point for technical queries
  • Review and validate Technical Deployment Package (TDP) content with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring all details are clear and executable
  • Collaborate with Sales Engineers, Project Managers, Technical Support, and Field Service to resolve design or product-related issues
  • Maintain detailed as-built documentation for future upgrades and reference
  • Participate in customer kick-off calls and provide guidance to pre-sales teams to align network design with serviceability standards

The Must Haves

  • B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, or related discipline
  • Experience in a network engineering or related technical role
  • Basic theoretical and/or practical knowledge in one or more areas:
    • Layer 0/1 (SDH, DWDM, ROADM, Control Plane, etc.)
    • Layer 2-3 (IP protocols)
    • Scripting/DevOps (e.g., Python, Java, Ansible)
  • Strong customer service and communication skills, including fluency in German (native) and English (written and verbal)
  • Proficiency in MS Office applications (Visio, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, analyse technical data, and translate designs into deployable solutions
  • Flexibility to travel (~25%) and support night-time maintenance windows (~25%)

Assets

  • Experience collaborating in matrixed teams across functions like engineering, support, and field operations
  • Comfortable managing multiple projects and resolving technical issues under tight timelines
  • Strong documentation and process development skills
  • Availability to travel (~25%) and support night-time maintenance windows when required
  • Customer service-oriented mindset with a desire to build a technology-focused career
